text: Terrible service. Every drink in the order was wrong. Starbucks should be easy not this slow and inefficient. She also couldn't figure out how to take payment with the app - how is that possible.

O.M.G. WORST SERVICE EVER! EVER! I have to say that the service was so slow and she got so many things wrong with our meal that it was actually funny and we ended up having a good time because of it. I actually would recommend going here just for the experience - really, its so bad its funny. I
They up charge you for a smile! 84.00 for a family of five to eat sandwiches, I reluctantly went ahead with it. Prices DO NOT REFLECT actual charges very fish and not trustworthy for travelers.
How corporate has not removed the franchise from this owner is beyond me. If you want to see how to run a fast food organization watch this video. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ohc8QoJVslg

I honestly do not understand why this place is so popular. I have tried the food here on three separate occasions, all of which were extremely disappointing. Salad was wilted, kid's meals were tiny yet expensive, chocolate pizza was disgusting, ice cream sundae arrived completely melted... should I go on??? Philadelphia has such an incredible food scene, so please do not waste your money coming here.

went to The Daily Bagel and found a hair baked into my bagel, when i took it up to show the lady who placed my order she turned to her staff and said, "Alright, I don't know what the deal is but we found ANOTHER hair". i use to love this place but after that and hearing that i had to turn down the free sandwich they offered to give me to go

Good parking but that's about it. The food is lower then average and the prices are horendous. The facilities are 1950 - terrible! The races (all of them) have seen a tremendous decrease in attendace to the point that one of them (F1) is no longer on the schedule and another (Brickyard) is about out the door. This place was special when the main series that raced there was the only series that raced there. Now it's a shadow of itself in virtually every way, shape and form.

fuck this place ***TOURIST TRAP*** $13 sandwiches & bad attitudes with the bitchy hispanic cashier katrina should have put you out of business for good do not waste your time in the line the reason theres a line out the door is due to lack of speed
This place sucks. It took us 30 minutes for the old ladies to serve us. AND THEY NEVER DID! And we just went to mcdognuts

This is probably the worst Dunkin' Donuts I have been to. Been multiple times for specifically their cold brew and they've been out or forgot to make it every sing me time. Staff was super inexperienced and unprofessional. Use the Starbucks directly across the street if you don't want to be disappointed.

Absolute worst airline I have ever dealt with. They boarded all passengers on a plane with a leaking engine and made us sit there for over an hour. After we got off the plane the staff was so rude to us giving us attitude. Waited hours to get my luggage back and for them to figure out another flight for me. Complete bullshit. I will never book a flight with American Airlines again.

45 minutes to check in. 1 guy working at the front desk and 31 people standing in line. Still have 9 ahead of me, doesn't seem like they want people to stay here or they just don't care. Makes sense why the Atlantis is sold out (5 minute check in max) and why this hotel has a lot of availability. First and last time staying here for sure.

Went in for ice coffee, but they were out of ice and proceeded to try to sell me a luke warm cup of coffee in a plastic cup with no ice! I was quite surprised that they still rung it up full price and I was like, yo know what, its warm, forget it, and I left - without coffee. The girl never apologized and instead was annoyed that I didn't want the warm coffee! I'd rather her not waste my time and tell me they were out of ice. I had a much better experience when I went to Olde City coffee instead.

This hotel's property and rooms are FILTHY!!! The motel and the property are dirty. They have no clue or don't care to clean the rooms properly to American motel cleanliness standards. The bathroom light fixtures have bugs sitting at the bottom, faux wood veneer peeling off the floor, door lock was broken, no non-slip surface in tub (dangerous), cigarette burns on tub and bed blanket and refrigerator hardly cool, never mind cold. Also, there are a large number of weekly rate people who are sketchy and trades people who think it's ok to be slamming doors and yelling at 5:00 a.m. Breakfast is a joke. Find another place.

The owner shut down all indoor service and staffs the drive thru with the slowest skeleton crew possible. Expect to wait at least 30-45 min, even if there are only 3 cars ahead of you. The app is completely worthless. Order and pay on it expecting to be in and out. Not a chance. Quality is god-awful... If you don't think that McDonald's food can get any nastier than it always has been, swing on by.
RUDE cashier. Totally unwelcoming. Impatient and beyond rude. How do restaurants get away with such crappy customer service???

I purchased a medical insurance policy to comply with the requirements of a Spanish Visa Application. The policy was rejected by the Spanish Government. I cancelled, yet IMG deducted over $5000 in premiums after cancelation. That money was returned, but they refuse to refund the premium. They sold a bad policy, they will not return the money. People in the USA office are difficult, but the foreign reps are good to deal with; they just work for a sketchy company.

It isn't a bed and breakfast. It isn't a hotel. It's a worthless place to stay. Couldn't get the television to work though it was hooked up to cable. No one around to ask. There is a dead bolt on the door which is the only way to close the door. The only reason I stayed here was someone paid for it.

Smelled good, clean inside, this place should be good, right? Nope. Confusing menu and when I ordered they served the wrong entree. No problem, they fixed it. Then, the prices don't match the menu. Way over charged for what it should cost. We started eating our food and "this is interesting"... Nothing tasted like it should. The spices were all wrong, dairy in what was claimed a vegetarian salad, just... underwhelming. The corner store sells dog food and at least you know what you are getting there. Needles to say, I will not be back.
The fries had no salt on them. The tea tasted watered down and I asked for ketchup for my LARGE fries and they gave me 1 packet

Terribly rude owner who seems to think it is okay to yell at people for being anywhere near the patio space. The draw of Dunedin is the friendly/welcoming atmosphere and this place sticks out like a sore thumb fostering foul language and rude behavior. Clearly the owner is upset about other successful competition in the area and is taking it out in the general public.

The first time I stayed here I gave a 5 star review. The front desk was helpful and we were able to park upfront and everything was updated. Well now I'm back and of course it is awful. There is no more free parking, and the worst part is they control what you can put your thermostat to!!! It's very hot on the floor I'm on right now and the room smells very awful. I will never come back again.

This is by far the worst Dunkin' I have ever been to. For starters, if you plan on using the drive through and there's any amount of cars ahead of you, expect to sit and wait a minimum of 15 minutes. The orders are never correct and always taste old. And unfortunately to top it off, the staff is never friendly. Don't waste your time.

The hotel is very outdated, rooms need maintenance. Our room lights didn't work, we used our phone flash lights. It smells old and rusty. Plus, coffee machine inside the bathroom is a no no for me. I was too grossed out to enjoy my stay at the room.

Gross!!! I walked into the bathroom after an employee. He didn't wash his hands and he pissed all over the toilet seat!! If I was a woman I would be super grossed out and pissed off!! I didn't want a donut after that so I walked right out!

The worst starbucks I have been to. Obviously the drinks are going to be the same which ever starbucks you go to, but the attitude you get -as mentioned by another peer- from some workers is horrendous. Never going to go here again.

Don't bother driving off the freeway for this restaurant. I had the worst "tamale " in my life. At least they took it off my bill. My husband's French dip must have been left over from yesterday, it was so dry.

Let's start off with this place sucked, we arrived at 5pm outside wait time was 1.5hr wait. Inside we were told would be about 45 min. We put our name down had some drinks. After waiting what seemed like forever we were called for a table 1 Hour later. We were sat and ordered our food it TOOK AN HOUR AND TEN MINUTES TO GET FOOD!!!!!!! most of it is fried food!!! And the service was absolutely we had to constantly find our waiter to get any refills and anything we needed. The whole experience was terrible and I wouldn't even take my dog here to eat. Do yourself a favor and save the disappointment.

We were very disappointed in our stay last week. Our room was under some sort of reception space and it was a constant stream of noise from heels, people moving furniture, shoes, heels, more furniture. The food and the service in the restaurant was horrid and do not buy a "spa package" unless you want to get treated like a second class citizen. We did love the facials at the spa, that was slightly redeeming.

Stopped here to get a snowball in between classes. Waited in line over 10 minutes. When my turn was coming up she told the people before me she didn't have enough ice to make a lot of snowballs because they were supposed to be closed already. Cool. Next time say that before someone waits in line. Oh and I was there before they closed .

Terrible hotel! The rooms are ancient and not well kept. The walls are paper thin and you can hear everything in the neighboring room. For the amount of money per night it's just not worth it. Look elsewhere! I wish we did! Lesson learned.

Disappointed, tried and not true, won't return!! Food bland, not for the Cajun's at heart, or true down home southern cooking. Ham plate with red beans, potato salad, and grits was decent though too much rice. Shrimp Poboy good and plentiful, ham poboy sad story there!!! Over priced, and there's a reason the sign reads no tipping, it's taken out when you pay, and you pay before getting your food. You want good cooking marry a Cajun, Italian, and or southern girl or guy!!!!
The place that answers the question, "Can lobster be bad?" Drive on by. There are good restaurants in Reno and Truckee.

I recently placed an order for pick up. When the order was picked up, the lady at the counter was very rude, rolled her eyes, and did not seem to appreciate our business. We will gladly patron other local businesses that are more grateful during these uncertain times with the Coronavirus. The food was also under seasoned and not the usual quality we have had in the past.
I don't think they are still selling plants here. When I stopped by, it was just a landscaping service company. I called them to confirm.

This place is terrible. Every room smells like someone puked on the floor and then they tried to clean it up but failed but still left the carpets wet with toxic cleaning agents. Management has been unhelpful and at times rude. It was so bad we left our room at 1:30 am to switch hotels. Oh and it's the weekend of our wedding so we also brought about 60 other rooms of business to this fourth rate sh!thole. I can't stress enough that you should stay away. Terrible establishment. Disgusting. Avoid. Seriously.

Not authentic mexican food.Tastes very bland and not exciting.What a disappointment.Not worth the money.There are way better mexican joints around than this place.The food is not bad but definetely not good

Our family has stayed here multiple times over the last few years without any issues and we have enjoyed it. However our last experience was very unfortunate. My in laws were having issues with the TV and after around 4 attempts to fix it they asked to talk to a manager. The manager told the staff do what they can and if they were still unhappy that he would talk to them in the morning. The issues was not fixed. How is this expectable as a manager to treat guest in this manor. In the morning the manager was just as unpleasant. I highly do not recommend staying here for basic lack of customer service.

Run away fast. This is one scary dump. No dead bolts on doors. Three different attempts by people to break In. Luckily we jammed a chair in the door. No phone in room. No one answered at desk from cell phone until I dialed 911. We are on 4th floor nice rooms my friend us on the 2nd. Toilet paper in peep hole. Stains and other terrible things run away stay up all night and party but do not stay here

Disgusting! Paid $231 + $50 deposit. After driving for hours we get checked into a handicapped room and we aren't handicapped, it was filthy and barely cleaned! They would not accommodate and switch rooms, they where completely "booked" which had I went on Expedia I could of received a room for $95 under their completely booked hotel ! DO NOT STAY HERE! A 1 star was a privilege, I would of rated it -100. But they where oh so generous to give us breakfast, majority hotels offer free breakfast anyways! So upset!

Hotel is dingy. Carpets are old, stained and smelly. The room reeks of air freshener to cover the smell in the room, but the air freshener is just as bad! The walls are thin, could hear people talking and running water in the next room. Had to wait 1.5 hours and 4 calls to get airport pickup. Desk on phone was rude, hung up on me once and placed on hold without a greeting the second time. They are pleasant in person, but not enough to make up for everything. Plenty of places in the area, overpriced for a rundown motel at best.

Downgrade, on account of bleh salespeople. It's one thing to avoid eyes or whatever--I prefer to not be followed around the store, so that's cool. But to make a customer feel like they are intruding in your personal space by entering the store? What kind of shopping establishment has sales people who don't greet or bid farewell to customers? I seriously felt uncomfortable. Thanks, but no thanks.

Sadly, this place is not what it used to be. We had called ahead and were told 15 minutes. No big deal. We waited 30 minutes. Not a huge deal. We quickly placed our order and then waited over an hour to eat. Food arrived and half of what we ordered was wrong. If they knew they were short staffed then why fill every table? Why not tell us up front it would've been 30 minutes to get a table with an additional hour to eat? Really disappointing.

No outdoor adult pool?? Seriously? All that space and you only use it for 2 huge 2 foot deep kiddie wading pools, a splash fountain, and a lazy river that I can't swim in? Unless I want to do laps or go down a slide, the designer of this park was clearly not thinking of adult leisure. Waste of time unless you have children. NOT a POOL

This location has officially received three strikes from me . 1st when the gave me a salad way past the enjoy by sticker. 2nd when I found mold on the brim of my soda. 3rd right now when I just received the driest cheeseburger ever made, no onions or pickles on it as if I requested none. To top it all off every time I file a complaint, NO ONE reaches out to me with a response!
Worst rental car experience I have ever endured in 30+ years of renting vehicles!! Stay away from this location! One star because the return and shuttle were flawless.

This hotel is awful. It is dirty and does not adhere to CDC guidelines for preventing the spread of COVID. Hardly anyone wears a mask. I did not see anyone clean the lobby, hallways, or pool. The same dirt and hair balls sat on the floor in the lobby and my hallway for 5 days! Hotel is dirty and I found a roach in the bathroom my last night there. The housekeeping staff needs to do a better job of cleaning. The carpet in my room was disgusting. The entire hotel is gross and outdated. I will never stay here again. GROSS!!! Pay a little more and stay at the Hyatt or Westin. This place was a dump!!
What a dump. I traveled through last week. Garbage overflowing in concourse F along with broken toilets in the restrooms. Disgusting place.

Horrible company. Don't use them. Driver didn't help load my items and when I for help he ignored me. Then I pulled my stuff back out and said no thanks. He then rushed out of his van, slammed the trunk and called me a very derogatory name. Stay away!!!

Worst airport in America. Delayed flight which isn't their fault but LITERALLY EVERYTHING in the terminal closed before 8pm. Nowhere to get dinner. Nowhere to have a drink. At 8pm... on a bloody Saturday. And rude staff. Will drive to Ohio or Chicago from now on.
They say they give you "free" rides but in reality they still charge you. Please DO NOT download. They will over charge you. Its NOT worth it what so ever

Went to the location in Tampa for first time. Cool place when you walk in. I ordered a Large Latte with 2% milk and was charged $4.65. When I received my order it was in a SMALL cup and according the menu the cost for a Latte was $3.85. I let the Barista know that I had ordered a large and at that was told they only have one size. I asked why was I charged more than the $3.85 and was then told the there is a $.50 upcharge for skim milk. Should have been told all this when I ordered.

Very dirty when I checked in... food all over the couch, couch had several rips in it, etc. No surprise since the staff has not cleaned the suite since I arrived. The front desk also charges partial bills to guests' credit cards on file at seemingly random and unexplained intervals. Not a big deal but it is odd behavior. No room upgrade for Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite members. Like other reviewers with similar issues, I can't recommend this property.
My big gripe with Wawa is that they do not publish their prices, even on their website. I think people would appreciate knowing the prices of food they sell.

The employees were fighting amongst each other. Literally thought they were going mug the lone latina server. Unbelievable. This place obviously lacks good management. Oh and can't remember if food was good with all this drama. We got out of there fast. Never going back!

They are always out of the kolaches I want. I call ahead every time I go to make sure they'll be there and then they aren't there. These Kolaches aren't even nearly as good as any of the original Texas branches. If you're from Texas do not come here, they will be perpetually out of sausage and cheese kolaches every time and if they aren't they'll be subpar. Never even roll to sausage ratio.

Hate this airline. Very rude and difficult. Questioned my grandmother regarding why she needed a service animal. She nearly missed her flight. They need to be more sensitive to people with disabilities!

Worst rental car experience ever, possibly the worst interaction I have ever had with a business. Waited 1 hour in the line only to be told they did not have the class of car they reserved me, but could rent me something else for much, much more $$. Took another 45 minutes arguing with the attendant (Vijay) that I did not want to pay more than the original reservation, did not want to buy all his "extras". In the end, I lost 2 hours, and was pretty frustrated. I wish I had looked at all the bad reviews before I made the reservation. BEWARE BEWARE BEWARE!!!!!!!! Rent from someone with a better reputation!!!

Worst casino in Reno/ Sparks. Dirty. Ugly. Slow front desk checking people in. No room service- phone rang for 45 minutes without a answer. I actually called bAck 4 times, went down to the front desk, and went down to the restaurant. I will never stay here again and would never advise anyone stay here. The bedrooms were scorching and couldn't cool off. This is not much better than a motel 6 on the ghetto

Female manager with blonde hair is incredibly rude to people in customer service. Would not recommend based on how she treats people who provide her service in the community. Completely disrespectful and rude. Would not recommend.

Terrible customer service! One employee covering both Budget and Avis counter and the lines was 8 deep. Not what you want to experience after a long flight. I guess that's why they were the cheapest, no workers, lesson learned to pay more for quality service.

This place is hipster trash. This place tries too hard to be "cool"and instead just comes off as another pretentious mediocre coffee house. Not to mention they just close whenever they feel like it. They supposedly are open till 12am. What a joke that is

Been here many times and enjoyed it but I can't in good conscious give a positive review after today. I ordered a sandwich and was horrified to find the barista preparing food (and everyone else's drinks) with a blood-soaked bandaid on his finger. There were even hints of blood around the bandaid. I never saw him use gloves, and the bandaid was sorely in need of replacing too. He didn't even put a glove over it after I heard another customer comment about how awful his finger looked. Not ok, Rue de la Course. Please train your employees in basic hygiene and food prep standards cause I'd hate to boycott y'all for too long.

Lousy service so they get a lousy review. Sat down at an outside table for drinks and snacks. Just one server for the whole porch and garden, so she was overworked. However after 15 minutes of being ignored she seated some friends of hers right next to us and took their drink order immediately, then walked right by us without a word. We got up and left. The service sucked so we won't be back.

I will have to agree with the rest. I was spending $60.00 a week, for early morning meetings. I purchased four $10.00 gift cards, one did not get activated. When I brought the card, my receipt and credit card statement( with weekly charges on it)back, they simply refused to make the $10.00 gift card right. Lost $240.00 a month over $10.00.
Come on! A omelette with vegetables and cheese..... no grits or potatoes, and a biscuit for 11.25? Rip off! Way too expensive.

I'm an angry mom! I went into epic the other day with my daughter. But we left immediately because my daughter was afraid of Alexis. S, I found out your employee Is harassing my daughter Via Facebook. That is pathetic. Why would you hire a person like that? To hell with that.

The owners of this place are awful. In summer of 2020 they fired employees for participating in protests, posting about Black Lives Matter on their personal social medias, etc. Do not give these people your money.

Rude rude rude. Convenient location but the woman who answered the phone was rude AF and obviously really really dumb. You won't take more money to have one more dog than the 2 max? I'd pay double to have my third dog there but obviously makin money is not the goal here..... move on to your next choice
Run by very rude Asian lady who does not speak English and only point fingers. You can not touch anything in this store. Plus it's expensive.
Wish I could give zero stars. 3x the Fare because it's raining? Are you kidding? Have enjoyed this service in the past but this "surge pricing" has left a really bad taste in my mouth.
Ordered pick up, showed up 20 mins after placing my order and it wasn't ready. So I waited an additional 40 mins and food still wasn't ready, asked for a full refund. Poor customer service

Listing my friends tab as "Fat Fuck" was not necessary and shows a deep level of disrespect for customers. The owner did post a public apology to facebook, which we are grateful for, but it doesn't change the facts of what happened.
Actually, I disappointed, because chicken are really small and not good. Also, coffee flort was not good...!.

Have them another chance. Still horrible. Buns are always stale at this location. As stated in my last review, they do not care about customer service. I live close by but when I want McDonald's I go to 22nd and Kolb. Much better food.

Awful. I have flown into PHL about 20-25 times in my life. This is the 6th time that we land and have to wait for them to move equipment or find someone to drive the jet bridge. Do these idiots think this is rocket science? They literally know the second each plan is going to land and yet they can't figure out how to move shit prior.

I'm not sure what all the hype is about. I ordered fish tacos and they were so dry I could barely swallow. My boyfriend ordered the Baja fish tacos and they were a little better, but not much. The jalapeño corn fritters were okay, but what fried food with dipping sauce isn't? Base off this meal alone I would not return. We did not order drinks, I am assuming that must be the big draw. The person sitting next to me ordered the fajitas and they literally almost made me laugh. The chicken looked flavorless and rubbery. I wouldn't have been able to even try it if that was what I had ordered , looked like a microwave meal.

I strongly felt like I was a bother to them. Both times all I ordered was a latte. Gosh I wonder how bad things would have escalated if I bothered them for anything more than a latte. The latte was perfect but it's not worth the hassle. I work in customer service and would be terminated in a heartbeat if I treated anyone like I was treated. (Both visits) Disappointed.
Bought tickets to an event They over sale wasn't able to attend No parking waist of my money they don't care or refund that's how they make their money Avoid

All the young kids inside are racist unless you're white. And don't even think about coming in without a mask doesn't matter if the mandate drop and you're vaccinated they're throw your change at you and be rude no matter what.

This DD has the slowest and worst service of any that I have been to. It is not uncommon for the line to be 30-40 people long and I've waited in line for over 20 minutes for a black coffee. The workers are rude- when you finally get to the register, they are busy texting on their phone and make you wait even longer to order. If you haven't missed your flight already by the time you finally get to place your order, it will take 2-3 times for them to understand what you want. Large black coffee please. Who? What, large black coffee.

So disappointed!! Awful fish to rice ratio. Also the rolls were super messy. Half of the small amoint of fish was on the bottom of the roll. Unfortunately won't be ordering from here again. There are much better sushi options in the city.

Good afternoon, I occupied room 415 of Hayes Street Hotel 12/08-12/09/21. While checking out, the desk clerk name Hannah was rude, disrespectful, and refused to give me a receipt. All paying customers should receive a receipt. In addition, it's very unprofessional for customer service agents to not respond to customers questions or concerns. Instead, Hannah stated she been in customer service for 10 years and she could care less what I think. Very shameful customer service, and it is very unlikely I would stay here again or recommend. Respectfully, Malinda

Don't waste your money on coming here. Only one restaurant is open for dinner. If I just wanted a place to sleep I would have stayed elsewhere. Absolutely ridiculous that they are not upfront about what is open and closed until you are already checked in. You have to scan a QR code to see what is open and even that is a lie, we spent an hour walking to different restaurants that said they were open and they were not! Finally went to the front desk and asked them to write down what was actually open, she told me one! Very unhappy, will not be back, unless we are compensated for this horrible experience.

Do not go here! Awful! This was the worst experience I have had at any establishment in a very long time. My food looked and tasted like slop. There were flies around the Po Boy bread...I wish there was something like negative stars for this place.

Waited over an hour for my car. They could not find it. Spoke to the valet guys. They said the manager Christie. Overbooked and now they had lost car as it took some people two hours plus. Do not park at this place.

Grits have no flavor and that was the first thing to earn one star ...we came to the city to celebrate a friend's birthday and one of the girls in our party got her wallet stollen by one of the bus boys. This is the end of my review. What more needs to be said? Police and security cameras had to get involved and everything.

This restaurant received a 1 ONLY because 0 is not an option. This restaurant is falsely advertising Nachos Supreme as a Wednesday special at a price of $5 with no exclusions indicated. The menu defines Nachos Supreme as having either ground beef or chicken. The manager on duty/barmaid refused to honor the special, even allowing us to walk out. Not cool. We'll stick with Carmelita's for good food, service and management that this place lacks.

Maybe it has changed since i was there. Very pretentious way to much attitude. Food was eh. Expensive when compared to quality. Close to the river but they really dont take full advantage of the ambience. Just ok, could romantic enough for a date. No booze (something that they really need here).

This establishment is absolutely and clearly fullfills the stereotype of Asain-Americans not wanting/liking/respecting African-Americans. Everytime I go there the older cashier spits in the trash can before she checks me out and spits when I am finished. I asked my sister in-law was that common/normal (native of Japan). She said it is a sign of hatred/disrespect/dislike/etc. Wow!!!! Take my money and spit?!? Wow?!?!? I am going back Jay's on So. Grand or United Provisions. They respect the customer. Customer first, money second. Happy customers refer more customers, become returning customers and spend more money.

This never happened to me before in my life. I walked in, plenty of open tables, it seems kinds busy. Being new to the restaurant I wait to be seated... Nothing. It didn't feel like good service. I'm not going to beg them to feed me. Wake up!!!

I ordered a hot chocolate for my wife and I. By definition, hot chocolate is hot and has a good chocolate taste. Unfortunately, it was not hot and the chocolate taste was weak. I guess you should try the coffee. As an aside, the place was packed with hipsters and their computers. I don't see how the coffee shop can make money with this crowd stuffing the tables for hours. Oh well. That's their problem.

Worst service here! Sadly making me look for my coffee elsewhere. No reason to have such poor, unprofessional and generally unhappy/unhelpful service. Every-time. This is NOT a one time offense otherwise I would let it slide.

This place is a dump! Smells bad, dark, the rooms are dated. My room had patches of unmatched pain to cover wear and tear; dirty shower curtain; tub drain was clogged; stains on comforter and after all of this - housekeeping never came to clean room. The best thing I can say is good location and very nice valet staff. Don't waste your money on this place. Tampa has many other options.

I took my mom to Davis Island from New York. We decided to go to Fountain Square because it looked like it had a cool fun atmosphere. However it took us 15 to be greeted, and then we got our drinks, ordered and after an hour left because we still had not received our appetizer. Horrible service horrible everything. I was embarrassed that I brought my mom here bragging how lovely Davis Island was.

You seem to have made a big deal about being open tonight, which is very strange because you're not open tonight. The telephone number that you have on here leads to an answering machine for Whore Research. C'mon Mac-n-cheese, get your shit together!!

Great selection of spices but I'm glad I only bought oregano. I asked if it was from Greece and they told me yes. Maybe from Greece 2 years ago. When I smash it with my fingers I can't even smell oregano. Not fresh, not happy. I went on a tour and they took us here. Very disappointed. Ruined my soup!!!
The workers throw the food in the bag, didn't put ranch, and napkins in the bag. Rude service !!!!

not so great. room was small and misrepresented. did not have courtyard access. had to take another downgraded room with shared balcony and were denied any form of compensation. felt cheated. also, pool and spa is yucky.

This place denied my group of four patrons which tried to enter the casino. The security at the casino was rude and unprofessional, merely backing the initial reaction of the security guard at the casino floor. This is clearly a second-rate casino and cannot compare to the casinos of Las Vegas or the Bahamas. The worst I've ever seen. Avoid if possible.

First visit since the move. I had the burger, disappointing. Friends ordered breakfast items and seem ok. Just not the same attention to detail with regard to the quality of the food and prep. Unfortunately not a lot of choices at 10pm in St. Louis to eat.

Upon check in, the front desk lady was nice and courteous. We checked in the hotel past 9:30pm.Our room had 2 roaches, the bathroom smelled like urine like it was a public restroom and one of the towels was dirty. Notified the front desk at 630am and filed a complaint. Upon check out, complaint was not handled the way I had expected. I guess the front desk clerk didn't know how to handle it. Whatever. Complimentary breakfast was good- my kids loved it. Overall experience was ok. It could be better though. Not worth the price for the room.

We decided to get sandwiches here because we were still hungry after going to taco truck. My husband and I split the grilled cheese with bacon, and the grilled cheese with truffle oil and arugula. Both sandwiches were very greasy, and the truffle one was very salty as well. The bread was also really hard almost like it was overcooked in the toaster, not grilled. Their prices are high too. Not worth it.
Smoking dick. No Mac and cheese. Can't hear my order. Can't read order total at window. Smoking dick.

Pros: Solid view Decent wedding location Decent bar selection Parking was not an issue Cons: Bad internet (Which is a must for me) Very slow elevators I asked for a specific drink at the reception for myself and the Groom offering to pay and I could not get it. Old rooms
Suuuuuuper overpriced. The kids love it, but they aren't paying $2000 to ride on a tractor and pick vegetables. This place has become a complete moneypit.

Stopped by again a few months ago, was disappointed. The front house staff is super undertrained. We didn't stay to eat after we were told that it would be a 40 min wait. They had multiple open tables inside and out while servers were moderately busy/not busy with current tables. We went across to Charro Vida , worth it- we've been back about 5 times since, maybe more. Looking across the way back to Teaspoon, the couple that was behind us was sat within the first 10-15mins. So yes we could have waited. But the point is- not to give your waiting customers inadequate information on wait times.

Meh... I don't get the appeal. Over priced and under spiced. Better crawfish in Houston and the rice dishes I could make better at home. They wouldn't let us change our order so we force fed ourselves the mediocre meals.

I asked for a caramel Frappuccino with EXtra caramel and got a regular one. The pictures show they barely put any in the first place. Everything else I got was fine because I got a puppucino and a birthday cake pop but the actual drink they didn't! they were slow, the line had space for one car and shortly after I pulled in multiple other cars pulled in behind me but they still were taking long. The lady at the window was nice taking my order and giving it to me but other than that it wasn't worth it.

For ANYONE who knows Southern hospitality and authentic New Orleans/Southern cuisine, this place falls short of the glory. The BBQ ribs ($18.95), supposedly slow cooked, tasted just awful, as if they had been boiled and drowned in sauce, and the candied yams and collards were just as soulless as the rude lady at the takeout counter. As for the pralines (a variety pack), they were just mediocre.

Not that good, but it takes you from Trenton to Philadelphia. So that is good. They run late, and there is no real screen from the elements for the doors, but it is cheap There are no restrooms here, so you need to prepare! 0 Flushes

Mediocre at best. Ordered the spicy chicken sandwich an my husband ordered the Philly cheesesteak. We both had side salads instead of pasta. Salad was good with artichokes added in. The spicy chicken was a huge piece of breaded chicken with toppings inside a pretzel bun. Had very little flavor and was difficult to eat. Cheesesteak sandwich was better but nothing special. Tried to order dessert but were told they were out of both kinds at 1:30 in the afternoon (annoying). The waitress did let us take the beer to go, which earned them the 2 stars.

Went here for lunch... BUSY!!! Shared a table with a family in town looking at colleges for the daughter. Had the Soft Shell Blue Crab Poor Boi - the crab was a little over cooked and dry. Gonna give them another chance... stay tuned.
Standard inexpensive fare. Not bad. Appears to attract locals. Food pretty good. Found in the Gold Dust Casino. It's been recently "redecorated", but it looks pretty old to me. It is clean.

Two of us came down here for breakfast and sat outside. The staff wasn't friendly - very robotic. I ordered the Santa Fe crepe which was okay. It wasn't a memorable experience and I will not return or recommend.

I would not recommend this hotel it's over priced and they bill your room for valet charges without your permission for your hotel guests that come to visit for two days my card was billed $91.10(unauthorized) in room dining food was below average and very over priced. This hotel charges for everything for an upgrade it was $30 per night and nothing changed except the layout of the room. They would charge you for running their water If they could. Hotel hallways nasty and dirty for the price. I would NEVER stay at this location ever in my life. Oh and goodluck on your bates motel elevator ride.

I'm a fan of Mcdonalds and know what to expect when I find them on my travels. This place had a very slow drive thru time of about 10 minutes during my time of driving the field. Around 10am and 8pm is when I would stop by about 4 times total and everytime it was the same slow times. Worked at Mcdonalds and was a crew trainer before and know how it works and the average times all watched by corporate. No giant orders in front of me, just lack of urgency when it came tot he process. Food was good and the standard like all other places.

Hotel is wonderful great rooms and a nice pool!! But the customer service is horrendous from check in to ordering food it always seems like we are bothering them!! The front desk screwed up our reservation and then we felt like we are such a bother ordering food!! There are so many more options on the strip!! What a shame !
The homeless are aggressive in the front parking lot. Pack a gun and don't walk alone. The hallways smell of cigarettes and marijuana. There is trash stacked in the hallway. Would not recommend.

The hotel is beautiful and the location is perfect. We stayed for hot August nights and we had a excellent view of downtown events. The problem that will prevent me from coming back is there is NO AC. There is a unit in the room that makes noise but it does not work...did I mention hot August nights. We couldn't sleep well because it was so hot in the room. We did have a service man come up but he said there was nothing to do. The front desk suggested opening the window a inch. If the a/c worked I would stay here again in a heart beat.

Mediocre hotel. It gives off the impression of a modern, upscale hotel but it really isn't. The sheets and towels are very rough and the wifi is the horrendous. I've never experienced worse wifi connection, even in a motel, as I have at The Grove. I come to Boise often for work but it's tough to do work when the wifi is spotty. I would not consider staying here again. Pros - great location next to many restaurants and friendly staff.

I wouldn't really recommend eating here per se-- your money is always undoubtedly spent better elsewhere --however, Cosi is really not a bad spot to meet someone for coffee at (not to say the coffee is good, but it's alright). Plenty of seats and reasonable decor make it half-decent.

I came into this store this morning and the man making the coffee was incredibly rude and impatient. I had questions about my drink but he could not be bothered to even hear my question. Yes, the place was busy but I don't see that as an excuse. I come here all the time when it's busy and I've never had service like what I received today. I'm extremely disappointed in the service I received and felt compelled to write a review so management knows about it. Normally La Colombe is a 5-star experience, but today.... not so much.

I'm so bummed about this place. It use to be one of my favorites but it's just been going down hill recently. Last time I came in they completely changed their menu and all my favorites are gone and they raised their prices on everything else. I'll have to find a new place to go.

Where's the beef? Just sizzle, empty desperate smiles, and many vacancies. places came and went-lots of hype per research, part-time resident Santa Barbara developer who still cannot find this place's niche. Poor location, little parking, it was good as a grocery store. Now it's a quasi-tourist place for overpriced ''gourmet" american goods and wares. Read: another american hu$tle to carpet bag Santa Barbara and trying to copy-cat other real markets.
Do not go. Poor service, argumentative staff. I wouldn't go there with a free gift card.

Cold rooms (64F/18C). Bed covers that don't get changed between guests. And no apparent sensitivity to the water shortage/drought in Reno. Staff were friendly. This place is all about taking your money. If management responds otherwise, I'm happy to re rate.
again another mini doughnut place, not into this style of donuts however i tried the other mini doughnut places and this one is by far the best one. just not my thing

The service was tepid and disoriented. In fact, the appetizers (cold risotto balls and milky muscles?) were brought out 45 minutes after the entrees were served and to the adjacent table next to us -- mind you there was no one sitting at this table top. It was befuddling and concerning to watch the table next to us with no one sitting there receive our food. This situation encapsulated our experience: close but continuously wrong.

Coffee drinks are mediocre. Almost $5 for a small/medium iced latte. I wasn't too impressed. My latte was about 90% milk and 10% coffee. Maybe I should of gotten a beer.....? Service was not too welcoming, upon walking in, it was confusing where to go to order coffee. I love the MilkBoy in Ardmore and it was disappointing that this one did not offer the same atmosphere or service. I was super excited for this and it was a slight bust. But they have plenty of time to up their game. I will try again in a few weeks. Good Luck guys!
Meh. Service was bad- server was confused by the menu and everything we said. Crepe was dry and bland with broken hollandaise. French onion soup was over half soggy bread. Just very unimpressive.

The staff was friendly, but the servers and waiter used their bare hands our glass rims and utensils. This was disturbing especially since we are still trying to recover from Covid and is big food safety no-no. We asked for ice water and they gave us a 16 oz plastic cup of ice for us to share. The pancakes and syrup (house made) was horrible. Syrup was like water. Given the reviews, it was a Great Disappointment!!! Dee

very disappointing last night. been here many times. I went last night with my wife and another couple early before a concert at radio city. ordered the special dry aged strip steak medium rare. comes out cold. i never send anything back but I would have had we not been with another couple and wanting to be on time for the show. Just choked down what I could. It literally came out cold. disgraceful
People who work here aren't morning people either. So if you having a bad day/morning. Go get your donut, coffee or latte mix somewhere else. Employees here are grouchy af.

I used to love this place but have slowly seen them move away from the original concept in the wrong direction. They used to be able to heat up food in the market area and eat it in store in addition to the regular menu and now it is take out only. Lunch is great but the dinner menu is lacking and absolutely hate that they moved to full service. We sat outside for over 30 minutes before being able to order our drinks. Used to be quick easy and good, now slow and lacking.

Slowest, most non-customer service oriented Starbucks I've ever visited. Only 1 person was making drinks and the priority seemed to be the drive through lane. This is the most inefficient process/approach I've ever seen in a Starbucks. I visited this location on multiple days and different times during the day, always to find the same inefficient service. During my afternoon visits, the personnel were definitely not focussed on getting folks served and out the door...unbelievably slow!

The rooms were a little old and worn. The bedding was stained. The vents in the bathroom were dusty and the sink drained really slow. On the plus side, they reduced the parking rate for me and let me take wine from the bar to my room.

Went to this place a few days ago and ordered a LARGE concrete shake. Got it and it looked like a small if not mini. Their serving sizes are absolutely horrendous, the only options is a mini or large and 4$ for a large was a 6 oz size shake. I will never go back

Good masaka, highly overstated veggie burger (if there's no burger, you kind of have to call it a sandwich) lackluster everything else. Think they used week old veggies and over-fried their falafels in used oil. I'd pass on this place. There's too many better options or better chances to take in Philly, especially for Middle Eastern food. I might feel different if I were a hookah smoker...but hookahs are bad for you.

I want to like this place. It's so convenient after going to The Bar Method. I've been here for at least six weekends in a row and gotten coffee, pastries and smoothies. This morning we got our pastries right away. Then 20 mins later, after prodding them twice, my mocha was ready, but "I'm just the barista" told me someone else would have to make my smoothie. After 30 mins, our 2-drink order was finally filled. The pastries are decent, not great. The drinks are inconsistent (coffee sometimes cold, smoothies taste different every time). The service is bad. Really bad. They're nice people...but not organized and it makes for a frustrating experience.

We had brunch and despite it being overly priced, it was not very tasty. Mine was cold, They are charging a lot for the experience $15 for iced teas and $10.00 for three spoons of potato salad! There are other five star places in SB that offer far better value for champagne brunches.

This place is cute and may be a nice place to meet up with friends or get a meal, but if you're looking for a boutique coffee experience look elsewhere. We came here expecting a specialty coffee experience, but they just had batch brewed coffee. It was fine, but not just not what we were hoping for. They do offer espresso and pour over, but the staff was not confident in their knowledge of coffee (self-proclaimed) and so I did not order either of those. I did, however, find Tinker Coffee Roasters down the street and they made me a delicious, carefully crafted, complex pour over.

This WaWa usually stresses me out, the space is so small, and usually filled with college students who are always in the way or rude Penn/Drexel employees. You can tell good customer service isn't a priority (or at a majority of the wawa locations in Philly). I only go into this location out of convenience.

What.... horrible bubble tea. Bobbas were super soft, meaning it was cooked for too long, and there's no flavor. They only have one size, which isn't ideal for me and they were around $6. The place itself reminded me of where you would go to chill after an exam or just to meet up friends and chill. They do have frozen yogurt which I haven't tried yet, but don't get their bubble tea.

I got bubble tea here and was disappointed by it for multiple reasons. It was weird to me that half the drink was filled with ice and that made it harder to get the bubbles, which were hard. The taro flavor itself was okay, but the drink was overflowing the cup and there must have been a hole somewhere because for some reason while drinking it I kept spilling the drink. I'm not usually picky about bubble tea but I didn't love the experience. If I come back it will be to try other things on their menu.
I wanted to like the wine I purchased there, but unfortunately the three bottles I have taste like grape juice that should be in a kid's lunch box.

Spacious and comfortable rooms with HUGE flat screen TVs and a comfortable king-size bed. The location is very convenient and the in-house Winthorpe an Valentine is very solid. Check-in is very fast and smooth, and the staff are friendly and helpful. A solid Westin.

Sorry to say, but this place is over-rated in my opinion! Not a place to go out of your way to find and definitely nothing worth going back for. Not the beer, not the food, not the service, and not the atmosphere.

This place just plain out sucks. 1.) My living room is bigger than the casino floor. 2.) They have about 5 slot machines. 3.) They have about 2 tables. 4.) They wanna act all fancy but Grand Sierra is kicking your butt in every way. It's a nice casino...I'll give it that. It's just so boring. Only thing good about this place is the location. You walk to this place and maybe play for 5/6 minutes and leave the hell out. I have never stayed in the hotel but have been offered free nights plenty of times. I would probably stay here but just not play here. Why siena even exist.....no god damn idea.......

As Starbucks go, this one is on the lame side. Why? There is always a line, and it seems to move at a glacial pace. I guess when you are the center of attention in a super regional mall, and the line is always there, why bother moving at any speed other than 'this is what I feel like' doing. Its not like those customers will go elsewhere, right? Oh, wait. Yes they will. Note: I do like the seating area. Lively, comfy and well located for people watching... if only the service could improve.

On select registry which should mean it would be a beautiful well kept B&B This is not the case! Smelled like mold and bleach . Very dated and old. Inn keepers are nice but it doesn't make up for the poor accommodations . Would not recommend .

The food here is great. The selection and service is fine, not outstanding. But the real issue is the acoustics and the fact that children seem to run roughshod in an establishment called "Twenty Tap." This is not Chucky Cheese. I do not want to be in an establishment overrun with children, especially when I'm sitting in the 21 and over area. The main issue seems to be the acoustics in this restaurant, but it's not helped by the fact that children (including children's birthday parties) seem to be present every time I go here.

Hotel is under renovations and loud. Had to move rooms. Beds are not comfortable and 4 of the 6 elevators went down and the staff response was "how do you think it effects us?" Location is good, looks nice from the outside. It's ok on the inside but not worth the price.

This hop on hop off tour was fine except for one thing, the buses didn't come around often enough. While we waited at the initial stop to get on, we saw 3 of the Old Time Trolley buses come and go. We waited about 20-25 mins. We saw the other company's buses a lot, but ours not so much. We didn't want to get off for fear of not being able to get back on in a timely manner. Do yourself a favor and go with the other company!

New owners in the last year, no more free breakfast, the new menu makes sure your 5 dollar deal for breakfast, is totally covered. No more free glass of wine with dinner either. The menu has been modified heavily , and the food is not nearly as good. After 20 plus years of staying here several times a year, we will be moving to a new favorite place.
This airport is pretty drab with not much going on. Only saving grace is the place that serves hot fresh beignets. No real lounges here at far as I know.

Way overpriced. Not good food... after 300 dollars, I could've eaten at any restaurant in Reno and had a nice meal. Every dish was cold, with no flavor.... I don't get it. Had the escargot (didn't hit the mark-- no flavor), crab cakes (gummy), burger (way better burger anywhere in Reno), short ribs (terrible). What's going on here...

Pointless to go unless you just want coffee. Whoever does their ordering needs to be moved to a different position. I've gone there dozens of times trying to eat and the racks are bare except a few random donuts. When I asked about it the employees respond "you have to get here first thing if you want food, we run out every morning pretty early". One commented how much of a pain it is to "Deal with people asking for bagels all day when I've told them many times they need to get here early". "I tell the same people every single day and they don't learn". I have a pretty far out solution.....Make more bagels?
Usually I love this airport, can't say I agree with the strange policy of removing "all readable" materials from my bag by a security officer that looked like a neo nazi. Dark times.

Altough our tour boat captain was a good fellow, it is pretty reprehensible they dont inform you that there arent alligators to be seen in January. Tickets are still sold as though you are going to be amazed. Pretty much a let down to hold a baby gator with its mouth taped at the end of the ride. Additionally a connection could be made between our visit to this tour and within 5 hours, our credit card was cloned and used at a nearby walmart store as the start of a 5 day credit card spree. Oh yeah, lots of fun. Thanks

The food is pretty good - standard deli fare. My issue is with its cleanliness and overtly rude manager. She had an ugly attitude and made it a point to complain about the neighboring festival as we ate. Instead of removing outdoor chairs (so people visiting the neighboring festival), she should consider picking up a mop and cleaning the nasty place.

Here on a free 2 night stay deal. We've used many times in the past. Use to be our favorite spot in gamble, but tonight I sat down at the bar, put in my cash, and was informed new house policy is 1.25 a hand to get a comped drink, which would be fine for poker or blackjack, but I wanted to play keno. He said same rate. I'm guessing I play well over 500 hands an hour.... So yeah, lol. Anyway feel bad because they comped my rooms, but it's cheaper to just take a cab to the peppermill and back while I drop a few hundred and drink all night instead of 30 minutes.

This website should be quite easy but it's a mess. All it wants first is my location. I give that and then it takes me to events at nearby Barnes and Noble store. There is no place, at least in the iPhone to search for a book. One simple thing I expect to do at a bookstore web site. Some people still want to read books so heads up. I didn't need the complaints about your cafe in the store. Just where are the books. Some businesses no matter how much going for them, are destined to die. Sad to lose the last book store.

Worse experience for a nice hotel ever. I'll not stay here again and will not recommend to others. Rooms are nice but couldn't get tickets to water park, all pools were closed even though it was a holiday weekend, and we couldn't get in to anyplace to eat even though we called ahead and asked. Horrible customer service.

Great food, terrible service. Waitress didn't stop by once to check in, refill water or coffee. Then we had to track her down to get our check after waiting 20 mins...Probably won't be coming back here ever again.

From a Titanium Elite Bonvoy member. This property does not hit the mark. Ran out of hot water, nobody answering at the front desk. Let it ring 15 times twice. Low water pressure on 10th floor. Not sure the staff here understands the level of care required by Titanium level guests. Stay here if there are no other properties available. Surrounding neighborhood a bit sketchy. Gave an extra star because the restaurant food is excellent. Food at the Concierge level club was average, but the service at the club was great!

Hotel was an OK place to sleep, but only sleep. It is trying to re-brand and re-outfit as a newer hotel. Don't be fooled, this is an overpriced motel. Wi-Fi never worked and was way too expensive for very few outlets, bad lighting, and small bathroom. I paid 109 for something that felt like a 60 dollar motel. Not worth it.

We stayed at this park for 4 days. We enjoyed touring around the area viewing all the beautiful beaches. The park itself had nothing to offer. We paid for a premium site that had no cable, no WiFi and we couldn't even get antenna tv. It was awful. For four days we watched scrambled tv channels. For what we paid for this place it was a big ripoff. This park had no other redeeming qualities and most of the residents were unfriendly. We would never go back again and will not recommend this place to anyone else.

Expensive coffee, not that great. But what can I say its starbucks, that's what you expect. Save your money go to McDonald's, coffee is just as good (if not better) and lower priced. Try the hazelnut ice coffee at McD's its amazing.

I really want to like this place, but I think I should just stick to my good memories of this diner. There was a time when the prices and flavours were excellent/well-balanced -- my recent visits were disappointing. My food was oversalted/over-seasoned. The salmon I ordered was rubbery/burnt. The noodle boxes that I ordered for take-out could have easily passed as Oodle Noodle's -- I've always spent that extra toonie and ordered from F & N because Oodle Noodle always put too much sauce. It is quite sad to taste the lack of passion since it's gained popularity. Either that or their staff turnover may have to do with the quality of their food.

Unfortunately seems to have gone downhill once ownership changed. :( Former employees were very friendly and knew our names after just a couple visits. Current employees always seem frantic and stressed out even if there are only 1 or 2 customers. Cappuccinos and lattes are now incredibly watery, and directions aren't followed on online orders. They have also changed their cookies (presumably to those used at Au Bon Pain?), and they're not nearly as good. Hopefully things improve with a little time, but right now the change is incredibly disappointing.

Underwhelming rooms. The smell of cigarettes is everywhere. The Circus Circus Reno offers a wide variety of activities within the hotel including restaurants and shows but where it counts, this hotel comes up short time and time again. The rooms are stuffy, small, and feel very worn. The cigarette smell we expect in the casino somehow manifests itself in every part of the building which is very unfortunate. The Circus Circus currently seems like it's in the lower tier of Reno hotels, but with its location and accessibility to nearly everything it wouldn't take much to climb higher.

The food has never been horrible here, but man the drive through is one of the slowest I have ever experienced. It seems to just be a lack of staffing because every time I drive by late night, the line is always long and barely moving. I have just stopped trying it at this point because it is not worth the wait.

This tourist trap is in need of a major renovation. They have a free "theater" with a distorted documentary that is from the 1950's on a vcr? Does anybody remember vcr's? The museum is dark and dusty and hasn't been updated in well over a decade. Rude sales people that hover over you. There are so many other nice places to shop at for sponges and soaps. Mosey on down the road and you will find establishments that actually take pride in their business.

Omar's hi-way chef restaurant is located inside of a truck stop off the freeway. And it shows. The food is standard breakfast joint fare on the lower end of the spectrum. I had a strawberry belgian waffle and it was okay but they put on too much whipped cream. Luckily, I didn't leave here with food poisoning like other reviewers had.
what happened here? omelet was small and rubbery??? Coffee was still decent to above average,, seating is small and cramped as usual,,, Ill pass next time

Stayed for 4 days this past weekend. Pros: Clean, lobby and conference spaces recently updated. Great location: two blocks from the French Quarter, St. Charles streetcar across the street. Luke restaurant across the street. Cons: Dated rooms (except shower), dated hallways, broken "free" WiFi (despite two calls to the hotel IT desk; they never returned calls despite promising), satellite TV that kept losing its signal (this was a concern as the world events this weekend were traumatic), one of us got stuck in an elevator, one of the 4 elevator's door had to be manually opened each time it arrived on the floor, no refreshing of toiletries. Much better choices out there.

This place came highly recommended and I thought it would be a perfect choice for my daughter's first holy communion cake. I picked up the cake the morning of. The cake decorations looked stunning and the butter cream frosting was delicious. However, despite following their suggestions, the cake was extremely hard to cut through as if it were completely stale. I was mortified when the children were making comments about how hard it was to cut through their cake slices, truly struggling. I called the bakery to inform them of my dissapointment and was told the owner would call me back the very next day. I never received a call and will not be returning here.

I dunno if the servers have vegan brain fog or what but the service sucked so Bad I haven't been back. We sat there forever and they brought every thing out one by one. Horrible table service. I thought we were going to starve waiting. Their selection is missing my favorite items. The mushroom drum sticks. The California living hut had a way better selection of options. Including vegan desserts.

When we first tried Bagelicious and More back in the Spring of 2013 this was our "go to" place for fresh coffee and bagels -- I would have given it four stars at that time -- the bagels were delicious but the staff always got our order wrong. (Wrong bagel would have the wrong cream cheese). Not really that big of a deal breaker, however last week we were craving bagels and stopped by to get an order for take out. Ordered two everything bagels with egg whites. When we got home took one bite and realized that the egg whites were spoiled. Gross! Maybe this was a one time occurrence, but I cannot force myself to try it again.
Nice clean rooms good breakfast nice employees but it's a stones throw from the highway and a major off-ramp so it's an all night truck air brakes and noice.
Personally, I think its overrated. Once went once but had a poor waiter, I would try again but would not wait more than 10 minutes to be seated.
Food was good, some of the best in the Quarter but the service makes it not worth the visit. If I wanted elitist snobs I would have stayed in Los Angeles.

I don't know what's happening at this business but the last 3 trips I've had to wait over 20 min to be picked up at the airport. After 9pm service sucks. Either hire more drivers or get more vans but when a customer arrives at 11:45 at night all they want to do is get to their car to get home NOT stand around for 25 min. Will try another service.

Normally a great airport. During Covid smooth lines, social distancing, no temperature check. Most restaurants closed. Long line for coffee. Only option for dinner was club sandwich at Gasparilla bar open. It was ok. The terrible part gets to AA stating the middle seat was blocked, yet sold the entire flight out. No temperature check on plane, stating masks required, no beverage or food service. Flight attendants did nothing all trip. Very sad everyone is trying to practice social distancing and safety....but the airlines get a pass, and safety is not important as their cash position.

New place, limited options when I was there. Coffee was okay, nothing memorable. Refrigerator cases were bare with only a bowl of apples and some yogurts, some bottled water. Not sure I would go out of my way to go here. Inside is cute and comfortable and they have a meeting space in the back that a realtor was using when I was there. This place has potential, just needs more choices.

THIS particular MCDONALDS 10 Piece Chicken Nugget meal is over $7 ... why? You go anywhere else in the city and none of the other McDonalds restaurants are charging this much for the 10 piece nugget meals. Why is this meal soo much more at this location ? Nuggets, Medium Fry, and Medium Coke. Over $7. almost $8 if you round up... I wonder how many other meals at this location are priced up?

We had the worst check in experience ever. Beyond rude. We travel to Santa Barbara once a month and our favorite inn was booked. Chad was flat out rude and has never heard the word customer service. He refused to check our reservation by phone (we didn't have our confirmation in hand when we called) and although the room was pre-paid he insisted it was not was not about to put himself out to find out the problem. When he did find the information he did not apologize. Awful first impression. The room was clean, but dated, the view was great, the grounds were nice, but we will not stay here again.

Great rooms, however the water sucked bearly anything came out of the hose, hot water took forever, but that's not even the big deal the issue was our neighbor next door was super loud!. You can hear her whole conversation through the walls didn't let anyone sleep she was up till 3am till however long she kept the conversation going we left the room and went back home, the guy who was working night shift attempted to open our door! So you can imagine how scary that is!. I didnt feel safe after that..

Had dinner here on a Saturday night with my husband and parents. Restaurant decor is very nice in an historic setting, but that's about all I can say that is positive. Service was terrible -- waited for an hour for the main course to arrive. Water glasses ran dry continuously and not a server to be found. Menu is extremely overpriced for the food quality.

Really awful customer service. The gate to the underground parking garage malfunctioned and the car in front of us couldn't exit. It took over 15 minutes for an attendant to finally come out and assist. After letting the car in front of us out she had the nerve to close the gate and told us we owed $1.50. No apology for wasting our time. Step up your hospitality training Hotel Californian. Absolutely ridiculous.

I ordered a strawberry and watermelon smoothie. Their watermelon was pretty good but their strawberry juice was not juice at all! It was really milky and had like a hint of strawberry. Not going to go back.

I had the pepper steak with cheese whiz. It was underwhelming. It wasn't necessarily bad but it was kind of dry and I had to add ketchup. Also, the line was pretty slow, which didn't matter but you'd figure they could move it a bit faster. There's not a lot of seating upstairs but there are places to stand, which helps. I can't imagine standing in line for this on a hot summer day or night.
Nothing really special at all. One of the salsas was hot and I did enjoy the complimentary chips that came with my order but this is just like a Chipotle or a Felipe's.

I keep on getting fooled by pictures of hotels on the internet. Online, this place looks awesome, in person, there are tiny, tiny rooms and a ghetto alleyway where you park your car and go to your room. Also, the walls are paper thin. My husband (then boyfriend) and I stayed here for Valentine's Day and the couple next door were fighting all morning. We could hear the woman screaming and (what sounded like) throwing things around the room. We could also hear the man pounding on the door and yelling at her. It was actually kind of scary. The cops eventually came, but by then we were already up and couldn't get back to sleep.

The employees were nice but didn't seem to understand what was written on their own menu.. they had no sushi (hello, it's in your name!!). The flavor of the ramen was ok but they use some instant (or instent as their menu reads) ramen like maruchan for a jacked up price. I absolutely love Asian food but was extremely disappointed.. wont be returning.

Sabor is a decent place with efficient staff,but i get the sense that the food is cooked for "gringos" and hasbeen toned down in seasoning and, alas, flavor. Tacos were tasteless, rice was bland, refried was devoid of any texture--- just all highly forgetable. More zest at Taco Bell. Will try again maybe a more regional dish, but if consistent i'd say pass on this place.

Every time I order here the sandwich is not done right. I have ordered the Tri Tip Special which sounds delicious on the menu. Yet again it ended up being delivered with no cartelized onions and no au jus for dipping. And if they were indicating on the menu that the au jus was on the sandwich already - I don't believe it. I will say that the meat was beautifully spiced and cooked and tender, but it was not what the menu said. Also - in our order we had 3 try tip sadwiches ordered none were done right.
Ehhh, it's just OK. Order Diner food and don't expect more. St. Louis needs a nice diner. The staff need to pay attention as well.

I visited Pei Wei for the first time on a Monday night at 5pm. I was the only customer in the restaurant. There were at least three employees. I ordered my food for takeout at the front door before I saw the condition of the restaurant. When I was there I used the restroom, which had not had any attention all day. Even though the restaurant looked new, it was filthy. There were at least 3 tables that had not been bussed in over a half an hour. The floor needed to be spot swept. The fixtures were dusty. The standards of health and cleanliness seem to be a low priority. My food was good, but the atmosphere was awful.

Only giving 3 stars because of the service. Maybe I didn't order the right thing but I had the vegetable soup which was sweet too sweet for me it almost tasted like it had lotion in it! Then I had a roti which had ground chick peas in it maybe I'll try another dish another time but I didn't care for it
By boat or car, this is a cool place to stop and visit. Slides for the kids and big tables for groups.

Came here for lunch on the weekend. On weekends it's a limited menu. The service was great. Really liked the Bloody Marys. Food was ok. There was no presentation, just the food on a plate/bowl. I was expecting to be a bit more impressed by the food. I was overcharged a couple of dollars for one of the dishes. I think it was probably a programming error. My fault for not mentioning it to them. I'm sure they would have corrected it. Will give them a try on a weekday when they are serving their full menu.

I had a groupon for this place which is why I went. I tried the cheesteak, jalapeno chocolate and chocolate chip cookies. I didn't really like the cheessteak. A little weird for me. The jalapeno chocolate was good but I was very disappointed in the chocolate chip. The most classic of cookies. It was crumbley an fell apart.

New hotel so it's clean and very modern. Bed was comfortable and bathroom was spacious but the front desk staff really need to get it together. Check in took 45 minutes, after the girl at the desk added my credit card she gave me the paper to sign and my room key and said nothing else. Normally upon checking in a short explanation is given of breakfast hours, where the ice machine is and what the WiFi passcode is. It again it was clean and the bed was comfortable so I suppose I would stay again. Close to downtown without being in all the mess.

I'm local and I work a few doors down from this place. I really WANT to like them, but every time I walk in the salespeople are SO rude. One good thing--- they are great with the bulk packaged praline sales. Their packaging is cute and all and their product is decent... I just want to feel more welcome when I walk in the door.
I have stayed here a few times, nice since it is close to the airport and to where I do business. Free Breakfast and a good rate.

The cupcakes aren't bad but they look better than they taste I feel. Every cupcake that had something in the batter had completely falling to the bottom of the cupcake. Also the wrappers were not easy to come off. I was so excited to try this place but after getting four different flavor I more than likely will not be picking up anymore. The cashier was really nice so the is a plus.

They have a ever rotating staff and usually the coffee isn't as good as other Starbucks. There are better places to go in the area. The junction and the coffee place across the street from the movie theatre are better.

It was an okay food experience, the best part was our guide Preston. His passion for NOLA is infectious, and his love for the city is endearing. The portions are small, and at some of the places.... lukewarm to cold (maybe they left it out waiting for us?) Overall, get the tour for Preston and a walking tour through the French Quarter, not for the food.

Made reservations at the last minute at great rates to take a tour of UNR and it was closer than staying at the Peppermill where I have enjoyed stays before. I wasn't expecting luxury accommodations so I will say I was pleasantly surprised. I requested and was given adjoining rooms. They were basic and clean. I was not a fan of the flat sheets and found it odd that there was no comforter (not that I would have used it). One of the TVs froze but we were able to resolve it by unplugging everything. I may try somewhere a little more upscale my next visit but I wouldn't avoid Circus Circus for a value alternerative.

The Fox Theatre is an absolutely gorgeous piece of history that you must visit while you're in St. Louis, if at all possible! We've gone to several shows here, and have had great experiences each time. The seating is great, no matter which seat you're in you can see the show. The 3 star rating is based on the ridiculous parking situation, the shady neighborhood you have to deal with as you're entering/leaving the show, and the lack of accommodation for the HOH/deaf community.

This place was just... okay. I really could have done without seeing this place. It was kind of cool seeing some of Andrew Jacksons things but it was really boring. Many people we passed though the first main building were just sitting on benches on their phones. The actual mansion wasn't impressive at all. The tour guides were very informative but we were only allowed in the hallways and the rest of the rooms were viewed behind pieces of glass. The only thing here that I was actually interested in was where Andrew and the rest of his family was buried in the yard. It was in a flower garden next to his wife in a monument.

The hummus was AMAZING, so were many of the first course options we tried. I loved sitting at the bar and getting to look into the kitchen and see how everything was made. The ambience of the restaurant is dark and romantic. It was a lovely place to celebrate our anniversary. The only thing that concerned me was that our last course of chicken was completely raw inside. We were embarrassed to send it back and were too full to eat it anyway. Just be careful ordering the chicken, maybe it is supposed to be like that?
The bagels are awesome but what's up with the hours? I showed up at 6:55 this morning (Friday) and it was all closed up. I thought they opened at 6:30. Oh well, I'll go somewhere else
Service was great as always . My fav ginger (Josh) wasn't there though. Nothing like a True North first thing in the morning

A budget hotel. First room I checked into had some kind of odor, so I checked into another room, and it had a similar smell so I concluded it was probably the detergent they use when washing the linens. Smells kind of like body odor, not very pleasant. The room is also noisy, as you can hear lots of random noises outside. since it's near the airport. No gym, and the morning breakfast had very few options and no hot food. The plus is it's in a great location, and the front desk staff was friendly.

What can I say? It ain't what it used to be and I hate using this saying. Darn me. It's still an alright place to hit up once a month and the chicken is decent albeit a little expensive. It's a chill spot to grab some drinks too. The screen is a little too bright for me, but I suppose it goes with everything else in the place. Oh, and the statue that greets you at the front door kind of scares me...

Had breakfast this morning and was a bit disappointed. Orange juice served was old and it tasted nasty. Food was ok but nothing to brag about. Coffee was weak and they didn't refill it. Service was minimal. The place was renovated 3 months ago, and it looks beautiful and open.

We were on the NW side so thought we'd give this place a try. Their stuff at the Greek fest was good so go to the source right? Large portions couldn't make up for what was, at best, food court worthy fair. Dry, underwhelming gyro, pizza dough "pita", and something off with the baklava (not as flaky tender as I was expecting). Wouldn't make a special trip from our home on the east side, and will be bypassing for something else when we're up this way again.

I have been back several more times since my last review. The homemade potato chips are well seasoned. They took the horrible spinach salad off the menu and replaced it with a shredded kale salad with parmesan vinaigrette. Much better. They do need to diversify their salad menu more often. Or perhaps add one more.

First off the restaurant has a cool vibe and nice layout. The chairs they have in their reservation area for larger groups are horrible. So uncomfortable. The service was decent. They forgot a couple drinks and dinner took almost an hour and half to come out. They showed us the cuts of meat raw that we ordered which I thought was cool but unnecessary. Now for the quality. The meat wasn't up to the price tag. The ribeye was fatty and barely any meat for 20 some dollars. The sides were good and expensive. Overall I was disappointed with this restaurant which I was looking forward to going and trying.
