Its a new restaurant so I will give it another try...My lunch partner loves clam chowder and lobster...the lobster had a freezer taste and wasn't the best but liked the clam chowder. I thought the Fish and chips were ok a bit greasy. Not sure if the product is actually homemade or shipped in frozen. Prices are high for Midtown - Reno. Guess they get away with the high prices in Truckee. This is not the yummy Tadich Grill in San Francisco but based on the prices you think you are in SF. I will try it for dinner and report back.

The staff is very kind, the room so dusty, the mattress little old, food is great thougha little pricey. One more thing, my room doesn't have sound proof windows, I heard the highway noise the whole night.

I am assuming this is the Starbucks on the lower lever of the Target at Springfield Mall? If so - I had a perfectly acceptable experience here - ordered my usual Venti light ice green tea lemonade. No issues. Fourbucks aka Charbucks is pretty standardized. I went on a weekday morning and it was not crowded - but I have seen it on weekends and it can get busy.

Onion soup was amazing! Great presentation & very tasty, Lobster was fantastic, the side veggies were very bland and horrible, I Would have given a five star but for that the entire meal needs to be fantastic. The donut hole desert was also amazing '

I've eaten here quite a few times and the food and service has always been outstanding. Today not. I've nw been waiting 55 minutes since my table placed our order and we're still waiting. The waitress is avoiding us as well. Unsat. When the food came it was delicious as always. I spoke with the manager and he appologized for everything. We'll be back again and hopefully the service we receive will be back to excellent as it had been on past visits.

Our family was visiting from California. We heard a lot a good things about Mother's so we decided to walk over from our hotel. We waiting in line for so long outside the restaurant. So that we didn't miss our flight, we ended up saying forget it and had Starbucks for breakfast. We were really disappointed and hungry. So the tip is: If you plan to visit Mother's eat first because you'll be waiting for a while.

Not the biggest fan of casinos but I had time to kill and it was the only game in town. Nothing special about gambling in this place, especially compared to big casinos for other cities. I'd recommend to check it out as long as you're in the neighborhood.

I like Rooster, but overall I feel that it is overpriced for what you get. The atmosphere is nice, but somewhat cramped. It's pretty difficult to find parking at this location, so that's a bit of a con. The food is good, but again, not the best breakfast food I've ever had. I'm a big breakfast gal, so it takes a lot to truly win me over!

The only reason I was turned off was the pick up. After a stressful travel day...I did not need to listen to the dinging ( loudly ) of the drivers seat belt alarm...all the way back to parking. Ben needs a little lesson in customer service and safety...buckle up Ben ...so annoying that you didn't care about our comfirty...that's why we didn't tip you Ben..‍

I come to this specific speedway 3-5 times a week for 3 things. House coffee, hazelnut creamer, and a breakfast sandwich. Usually all 3 are guaranteed when I come in around 9am. Lately, they've been out of breakfast sandwiches by 9am and today there was no house coffee ready. (It was brewing) but to me, that's annoying. Also, Ash at the register should learn some customer service skills or get a different job. Bring me back the people that worked over the winter! They were amazing!

This was our first stop on our recent visit. The line looked daunting but moved pretty quickly. The hard part was finding a place to sit, which we were able to do eventually. It was all tourists. The server/bus person we encountered told us something curtly about where to sit but we weren't able to understand. Anyway, our food came pretty promptly. I enjoyed my fried catfish po boy. The hot sauce on the table really added something. My husband however did not care for the famous ferdi. I tried it and it was sort of just an average meat-meat sandwich.
Hot chocolate tasted like warm water. Beignets were ok. Not nearly as good as Cafe Du Monde.
this place is decent. the selection is lovely, however the service could be better. they really need to consider keeping open past 9 pm on fridays/weekends

This place is a decent boba place. I only go here because it's the only boba place closest to me and because Tucson isn't really known to have any good boba places. I'd say the price is pretty expensive for what they give you. This medium milk tea was around $5-$6. It is very diluted and you cannot taste the tea. It is definitely made from powder and probably just water with boba. The boba balls itself are not warm when they come out and sometimes they are undercooked. They don't have sweetness percentages so you can't adjust the sweetness. I'm giving them a 3 star for their customer service and that it's better than chatime.

It is what it is- a cheap place to stay for a short period of time. It is loud all throughout the night and the walls are super thin so you hear everything. The beds are uncomfortable and the rooms are not that great or clean. However, I needed this room just to "sh*t, shower and shave" so it was perfect for that. I might consider staying again for a short period of time. It was also a short Lyft to French Quarters and walking distance to some cute stores and restaurants.

I needed to stay for one night in Santa Barbara to recover from a surgery, and although I was very pleased with the room and it's cleanliness, the noise level was ridiculous. The walls and windows are very thin. Other guests were loud as they stumbled in after midnight, shutting doors, rummaging around in their rooms, and you could here head boards slamming BUT if you're hard sleeper and aren't bothered by noise, then this place is perfect for you. It's just a few blocks away from the major stores and restaurants.

Ordered to-go: muffuletta was fine but I've had much better, I personally like when the olive salad seeps into the bottom bun but that didn't happen here, it was pretty dry. The debris fries were just okay, would've been better with a side of ranch.

They need more help in the mornings. Between waiting to order and waiting to get my coffee and bagel - 20 minutes. And I went inside for the carry out because the drive thru line was too long. And I got the bagel long before I got the coffee.

Good prices, good food, never order the soft tacos if ur really hungry unless u order several, they are really small. Don't sit outside unless u want bad service. Normally they have 1 waitress out there with 7 tables!

This place is crowded like most Starbucks and the coffee is too bitter for my taste. My main problem here (and all Starbucks in general) is the generally slow service. The staff are mostly good people but there seems to be a lot of chaos. It seems like most of the work falls on the barista and the rest of the staff doesn't know what everyone else is doing. Go to Saxby's instead.

I arrived in Philadelphia at 11:30 am for a work conference and was staying at the hotel. My room was not ready and would be in an hour, so I went to explore for a few hours. I went back at 5:30pm, still not ready! So they gave me another room, I went upstairs I felt like it was back in time, the furniture was old and no USB ports and bed skirts were stained and the fridge was unplugged and smelled. The employees were amazing, they were so helpful and incredible. But the hotel needed updating. I will go back once the hotel is completed in the updating stage is completed.

I came here for country music but I got rock! I would have thought that this famous venue would be bigger - but NOT. It was about 1/2 or 1/3 of the Radio City Music Hall in NY. Nevertheless, the acoustic was excellent and I was deaf by the time I got out in the evening. um.. what did you say?

I had VERY high expectations after seeing this little shop on Cupcake Wars, so unfortunately, because they were so high, I was a bit disappointed. I had the cookies n cream cupcake; it was good, but not out of this world like I was expecting. Maybe I should have tried a different kind. The shop itself is very cute with nice seating areas. I will most likely give this place another try the next time I'm in town.
Cute cafe, fast service, we stopped to get a cup of mint tea and Hot chocolate. They offer pastries as well.
Good coffee but almost any thing is "extra" and have to pay more for it. Cashier a little grouchy but they can whip up a mean batch of coffee at the end on the day.

So-so bbq...very nice people though. Waited 30 min for 2 pull pork sandwiches ( they have a sign so it must be normal) ...ordered one large...the only thing larger about it from the regular was the bun size....small portions all the way around. The bbq is good..ill go back and try again. If your in largo try smokin rib shack on west bay...order the cdub sandwich..it feeds two people and is awesome bbq.

The owners seem very accommodating and certainly seeing their house is a trip. When I arrived, the woman told me she didn't have any cruisers available. She pulled out a bike that I guess she doesn't normally rent. With good reason. The pedals felt loose, and the gears kept slipping. For $20, this was only an OK deal.

Stayed here from march 23-25. Rate was 129.00 per night w/ AAA. Parking was 26 per day. Got a free upgrade to a suite after booking a double. Hotel needs updated like the crowne plaza a block away. Decent hotel. Go for the Crowne Plaza if the price is close to the same. This visit was $60 more per night.

Your typical soho spot honestly. In the sense that the atmosphere and people matter more than the food. The place is super cute, my friends and I came for a Sunday brunch. One of my friends got the café con leche and it was not good at allll. It was also served cold. I got the two eggs over easy with toast, bacon and tater tots. It was good however my toast was cold and a little too greasy for my liking. Overall, we had a nice brunch but I wouldn't eat here again.

Breakfast is cheap but you get a ton of food. Reminds me of a small town diner. Most people will order food for pick up or delivery but they are always busy in the AM with those orders. Rarely will someone eat in. Service is average for a diner. Free parking is helpful. Would recommend if you are hungry for A lot of food for breakfast!
Coffee is ok (cafe dumonde is better). Beignets are slightly fluffier here. Service was extremely slow and disorganized.

The food is exceptional. But the restaurant lacks the ambiance and experience to fully drive it home. It doesn't help that our waitress was neglectful and incompetent. I don't want to sound harsh. I just don't know what other word would fit. I still don't know if I will return. I hope it's just due to the pandemic because it is a top rated restaurant.

Nice setup and place, good quality service but just ordinary food... Like too many time in places in Tampa area, much more care has been spent in design, decoration, employees uniform than in what you will have in your plate to eat ..

Service was good. Funky Korean music was too loud. Spicy and soy flavored chicken wings, a must try at least once! 4/5 Bulgogi over rice, sautéed in a pan? Not very appetizing, would have been better if it was grilled. 2/5 Spicy squid over rice 3.5/5 Drinks were good though

When I first checked in, I loved the homey and comfy feel! Everything was modern and it was in a tight (but comfortable) space. The things I didn't like was that I had to pay extra for wifi?? Which I didn't know was a thing? And the bed frame was a little inconvenient because the bed was able to move around, the frame did not hold it in place. Overall, pretty good experience but could use a little improvement.

Was really looking forward to trying the place out, ended up being a huge disappointment. The beers were okay, nothing special. The food was extra salty with no other flavor. The tacos were dry and the jalapeño poppers were cold. The bartender was nice but the cook had a really bad attitude. The best thing it had to offer was the atmosphere.

This place was fine to grab a coffee. I was a little bummed that there were any type of breakfast foods with substance, but it actually appears to be an incredibly common thing in the area that cafes only really serve caffeinated drinks. The place was pretty empty when we walked in and our drinks came up promptly. It wasn't great enough that I went back (instead I started heading to Rouses' Market), but I certainly wouldn't turn my nose up at it.
Pizza was good. Everything else is basic. Doesn't matter, they closed down now so good night basic Italian place.

Service was great. Servers were very personable. Too many selections in in he menu. Hard to choose. Sauteed alligator meat was very tough and chewy, and not much meat in the poboy. Red beans and rice was good though. Place was clean though.
Quick, clean sandwich shop right on State Street. Grilled cheese sandwich had tomato and avocado on multi grain bread. Came with tortilla chips.

Got a half dozen from here and like many of the past reviews thought the donuts were just okay. Most were dry and hard to swallow and flavors weren't that great. The only one that I'd get again is the old fashioned and the Alice in wonderland.

Es un lugar seguro pero quizás no del agrado de todo el mundo. Muchos morenos/africanos y mucha venta de cosas fake. A parte todo es como un misterio, secreto, te ven y si no les parece familiar creen q son de la policía y te tratan súper nasty, frío y con secretos. De lo demás todo bien, estacionamiento grande, lugares para comer, ambiente ameno, solo ese detalle y procura llevar carteras pequeñas y cerradas porque hay mucha gente que pueden entrar sus manos en las carteras sin zipper y llevarte lo que tienes adentro.
Had to change the very very unenjoyably sweet amaretto iced coffee to a Cappuccino that was better.

After pinewood social was a pretentious dick we decided to try this place for lunch. The beet and goat cheese salad was so delicious but it's unfortunately too small to just be your full meal. The Mac and cheese made a tasty, creamy accompaniment. Also had hash browns but they were way too greasy. I tried the housemade ketchup but didn't like it. It tastes like applesauce. I want to try more plates here but I'll prob smuggle in real ketchup just in case I have fries or a burger. I'll be back.

FYI GREYHOUND DOES NOT SERVE RENO UNLESS YOU BUY A TICKET FROM GREYHOUND'S "RENO AMTRAK" LOCATION. If they sell you a ticket from "Reno" to Oakland, the bus will depart from centennial plaza at 1421 Victorian Avenue. It costs $2 to travel from downtown Reno the the Victorian Ave station, and it is a 10 minute local bus ride.
The rooms were cleans wasn't like the other reviews it was decent for last min not dirty at all

The people are very nice and I want to love it, but it has 2 problems I can't get over. #1 no a/c and usually no fan. It gets HOT in there for real. #2 food is $$$$. Like every crepe is $10. Crepes that aren't even a big deal are still that $$. I could buy a gourmet sandwich around here at places like Telas for way less. Make it breezy and affordable and I'll happily return

We stayed here for a night and the experience was so-so. We felt like the staff at the front desk was a bit dishonest...on the phone they gave us one price then in person another. I've gotten better rooms elsewhere for a better price than here. Toilet paper rolls were used like it weren't replaced from the day before. When we asked for another roll we got another used one

This was my first visit. I ordered a crepe with veggies and it was really good and my friend ordered the Nutella crepe which looked wonderful. There is also a great coffee menu and the coffee is stellar. I just wish there were more seating available. I will be back to explore more of the menu.

With three levels, if the band sucks on one floor, you can always just skip up or down and try your luck on another floor. The views from their balconies are pretty stupendous and the people watching was top notch. That said, the night we were there it was inundated with bachelorette parties and large groups of bro-types. (See above note about people watching) The drinks were pricier than a lot of other places we went nearby, but the service was good and the bartenders were all friendly. Overall, good for some entertainment, good views and good people watching... just ultimately not my kind of scene.

Today was not a good day for some reason. I ordered the Redbird with chicken. They must be using less spinach, which was a drag. Also the chicken had a lot of googlies which was gross. They did try to rectify but by the time it was remade I wasn't feeling it. I'm giving 3 stars because of the chicken...I felt it was a little half assed for them to serve that. But usually they are pretty good and worth the try.

I had heard good things about Red Sun, so I decided to try it for dinner. When you walk in, you order at the front counter. They have menus for you to look at and decide. I ordered a few sushi rolls, and my friend did as well. They bring your food out to your table, and the food didn't come out at the same. I had to wait quit a bit longer. I thought the sushi was average and very salty. It resembled the same quality you would find at the grocery store.
Clean room but creepy front desk guy. Breakfast was adequate and attendant was very nice. Gave us bottled water for the trip . A nice touch.

Decent hotel, served as a good home base, but kind of dated and nothing too special. Kind of small room, and a nearly non-existent window. However, this place was much cheaper than comparable hotels, and it was worth the savings. The good was that they had a water bottle refill station, and great front desk staff who had good recommendations for us. The lobby space was also very nice. Discount on the parking across the street, but i'd still recommend using Spot Hero, because it's probably still going to be cheaper.

The hotel was Great. The only reason I rated it 3 stars because it was my first visit. I truly believe rating something to high leaves no room for improvements. The room was beautiful and clean. Front was pleasant on my visit. I like the amenities: gym, pool and pool table. I would recommend.

This is all I remember: sweet, sweet, too sweet icing that tasted faintly of strawberries and a marvelously moist and tender cake beneath that had strawberries dancing in its tummy. I ordered the day's special cupcake: strawberry. How on earth did they get the cake so moist and delicious? Have no idea. But as for the icing, blech, how they got it so sweet is easy to figure out. Less is more. Really.

First time here, it was a little over an hour from my house so the location was great. The campgrounds and surrounding area are beautiful. There are some basic common curtesy rules but things seemed pretty lax overall.The "beach" looks nothing like how the website advertised. The mini golf and playground left a lot to be desired. The pool was great though and our sites were spacious.

I think this place is overrated. Based on numerous reviews and recommendations we went here. Donut was a bit better than average but it was quite expensive. I definitely had way better donuts in my life and the money wasn't worth it. I agree with some other comments the texture was very dense which didn't make it feel like a fresh donut.

Tria was a good choice for my Friday night dinner with a friend. They have nice, small sharing plates at a pretty reasonable price. BUT, our waitress decided to memorize our order, and then brought us a dish that we didn't order. We told her that she made a mistake, and she actually still charged us for the dish that we never asked for! Besides this blunder, the food was fine. The inside was a bit dark and small. I know a lot of people love this place, so my experience might have just been an outlier, but I think it is worth mentioning.

I wasn't thrilled with MilkBoy. (c'mon, Yelpers, I trusted you guys!) The food could have been better especially for how long I waited for it. I went around 2:30-3:00p on a Thursday and it was just OKAY. I only got the pizza fries, and the Hummus appetizer, but I had a bite of a burger, which wasn't spectacular. Great atmosphere, but not great food. I'd definitely give it a try for drinks sometime!
Food ok..nothing exciting. Service was average... Limited menu for brunch.. Will try again for lunch..some day Not crazy about breakfast menu.
Wish I had come here not so trashed for better assessment. Asked for a dirty martini with extra olives. Got a solid martini with 3 olives. Hmm? Chill spot. Liked the dark lighting.

This place needs some work. At the very least, they need to clean up the place, arrange the shelves better, and take care of the fresh vegetables so they do not get too dry. Sadly, right now it is kinda dingy and dirty.

Covid-19 excuse for lack of services needs to go. Not having warm breakfast each morning nor coffee or rooms cleaned is now unexceptionable. Marriott is taking advantage of this situation. It cost me an extra $150 to buy family breakfast and coffee for three mornings. Halls were filled with dirty towels and trash and the smell of dirty diapers is a total turn off when returning to our rooms and walking down the littered hall in the evening as well. A bit discouraged with this stay. T.

I agree with all the either reviews mentioning high prices. My impression from the first time we went here is that the quality is high and does warrant the premium price. I thought the ingredients for fresh and a quiche, while not the best I ever had, certainly what was enjoyable. We will have to go back to try some of the pastries.

We enjoyed our stay here we stayed between oct 1 - 3 but what we didn't know was the coupon book you guys left in our room expired the 30th of septembet which kind of sucks because we were going to use a some of the coupons but since they are all expired we can't it's just annoying.

Love the Pasta Elliston with a meatball. Coco's is one of the best Italian spots in town, but don't expect to get great service if you order pickup. After 5-10 pickup order experiences, I've learned that they may not answer the phone, they may not have your order ready on time, and they may keep you waiting at the register for ages. But, the food is great!

Absolutely beautiful hotel but the main "Living room" bar is a dub. We waited 40+ minutes for sliders and then they sent out the wrong items! They sent out the grass fed beef sliders when I ordered the black bean sliders. Vegan/Vegetarians beware! Check your food before eating.It's not busy and it's a Thursday night so i am not sure where the issue was. On the side note, my meat eater friends said the sliders were very good. Still disappointed that I wasn't able eat with the rest of my party that was with me. Wetbar is flawless and service is great!

This was the toughest course I've done in 10 marathons. I just didn't see why it needed to be that hilly. I'm not sure if there is a way for it NOT to be hilly but it takes away from the fun when it's too tough at times. The volunteers were good and I felt I had plenty of water and food. The medal was also great and shiny. The buses to the start line were good and easy to get to but my wife said as a spectator this was the worst for her to get from mile to mile. Wouldn't do it again but would definitely visit nashville again.

First time visit to Santa Barbara, we picked this place because all those good reviews. The restaurant looks very clean and special, we ordered special source with shrimps, tasted good! Crab with lemon pepper was too salty and fried brussel sprouts was over cooked...... service was just okay!

Fantastic upstairs area for people watching. It's a chain so everything tastes the same as it does everywhere else in the country. The Bathrooms were pretty dirty but thats to be expected when there is a 15 minute wait.

I was there a few weeks ago for dinner, the service was great but the food was pretty average, you can definitely find better Indian food in St.Petersburg for what you are going to pay here at dinner time.

good location and relaxation..a place to get yo Z's. If it's on a bed or on the floor, La Quinta provides a mediocre hotel experience. Sleeping on the floor is recommended only if you can bear the smell of poop that permeates the ground, some sort of phantom smell.

The hotel is impressive in size. I thought I was going to be spoiled upon walking into the lobby. The rooms themselves are a bit stale. The bathroom in particular was not very enjoyable. Personally did not understand how to get into the shower without rubbing past the toilet. Bathroom had random hairs laying around also. At the end of the day it was a place to sleep though.
This Casino/hotel is mediocre. I like the downtown location because it's close to everything you'd want to do in Reno.

I like Starbucks for the most part. It just doesn't make sense to pay $6 for a drink and they can't even fill the cup up all the way... there's no way they look at it and know it looks right. Wish they had employees that knew what they were doing. I haven't even taken a sip and this is what it looks like! Hate to complain and I normally don't, but paying $6 for this is kind of frustrating.

[PROS] - Close from train station - Close from Scottrade Center - Spacious room and affordable price - Clean linens [CONS] - Too much electricity issues (the light switch by the entrance is not working, had a power outage at night.) - Building seems old - View from window is not good at all
Food isn't that great, but live music performances and friendly service makes up for it! Great place to chill at while waiting for your flight!

This location is super convenient! Right off of Rittenhouse square, the location overlooks the park and even on a gross day it's nice to sit outside and watch people go by! I don't drink coffee, but I hear that it's pretty good here. I am more of a tea person so I went with the green tea - it was really good! It came in a fancy tea steeper and it was bagless so I felt like my money was well spent based off of that. It is a tight space though and the tables are small so if you're looking for a study spot, I wouldn't recommend this place unless you're ok with that.

The one star review on here is a bunch of crap. What a great local story. Doug and Brewmaster Dan have done a fantastic job representing Reno and providing yet another craft brew for us locals to enjoy. Patti does a GREAT job serving up thirsty fans at the brewery, which has a ton of character, cheap beers, new batches to try, darts, and a huge wall collection of beers from around the world. Oh, and the beer? It's tasty, the menu is growing and so is Dan's talent.

Can't go wrong with ice cream! Many different options were available along with a number of other nicely made & decorated treats! Located within central popular location. A bit too pricey for my ice cream budget but my waffee come sundae was delicious
The s'mores concrete was delicious!! I don't have any frozen custard places by me so it was nice to have something different. I definitely think it lives up to the hype!

Solid dinner. Was advised to come here instead of battling the lines down the street. Kind of a diner interior, but larger scale. Everything we had was great, from the oysters, crawfish, stuffed flounder, stuffed crab and soft shell po-boy. Large portions and no room for desert.
The food here is glorious! They are kinda pricey but it's worth it! They aren't very good for groups because it's such a popular restaurant. I will be back here again!
It's a great go-to when you want a healthy omelet for breakfast. They're delicious and made with a smile.

Great coffee shop in downtown Reno! My friends and I stopped by for breakfast on our first full day in the city. The baristas were so friendly and fun to talk to. I really enjoyed my vanilla latte. I also got a spinach and feta pastry and while the flavor was fully there, I wish they had warmed it up to taste even better. Overall, we had a really good experience and I'd stop by again when I come back to Reno

One of the best!! I have been in this great spot tow times before and I really loved it. I'm sure that I will go there again and again. Having lovely and smiley staff is the most important thing to attract customers, and they have this type of great staff. So keep it up guys. However, there is only one problem, fix the tables. ;)
I'm so glad this place is in Boise. The baguettes are so yummy (I like the BBQ pork) and the vermicelli noodle dish is fantastic. Great cheap place to eat.

As a coffee house, I'd prefer that they open earlier rather than remain open later, but their desserts are first rate. Two nights in a row we had excellent sweet treats, from a rich, perfect, if unimaginative chocolate cake, or flaky, yet chewy Butterfinger brownie, to classic red velvet and carrot cakes. The last two helped rescue a dismal meal.

Chose this place on a whim for coffee with a good friend before the holidays. I was pleased to find it warm and inviting with friendly staff. I had an iced tea which was very good. That's a high compliment coming from a Southerner. We take iced tea very seriously. My friend had a Chai Tea which she also enjoyed. I also appreciated the fact that you got one free refill on the iced tea. I'll certainly be back.

Enjoyed a brunch here with a group of 4. I had the croque Madame which was very tasty. We are on the second floor and enjoyed the decor. The restaurant itself is not very big, but we had plenty of room and they had no hesitancy accompanying my group when I initially thought it was going to be larger. Overall, a good experience.

We has a lovely stay at International House. The decor in our room was lovely - white linens on a HUGE bed and taupe accents. I loved the oversized velvet chair, huge crystal chandelier, and the Aveda bath products. Concierge service was great, and there were no hidden charges. My only complaint is the owner threw a huge, noisy party in the lobby one night of our stay. I think it would have been wiser to inform guests in advance as a courtesy. It was so loud, it was almost impossible to speak to the desk staff when we needed to. Party aside, we very much enjoyed our stay and will be sure to come back.
Pretty good airport. Though the layout is a bit confusing. I'll pay more attention next time I fly into STL.

(Pick-up order via Snackpass -- 40% all platters during happy hour!!) Rainy day got me in the mood for some warm, carb-y Mediterranean food, and y'all KNOW the happy hour deal at Hummus Grill is hard to resist. Tried the Vegan Shawarma Platter ($5.99) for the first time; I added sides of hummus, french fries, cucumber+tomato, fried eggplants (!!!! yes), and hot sauce. Everything is pretty standard, pretty yum -- plus the hot sauce is actually hot! Otherwise, decent grub for the price, and you really can't beat that Snackpass discount.

What a cute and quaint little coffee/tea shop, with bistro type foods to eat! We stopped in here on whim to waste some time before attending a wedding... AND BOY WERE WE SURPRISED!!! They have the cutest rooms for you to be seated while you enjoy your order. They even have a creative room to help get the CREATIVE JUICES FOLLOWING! There is also a little area to shop for little items made my local artist. The items in the area range from handmade necklaces to scarfs to magnets and post cards. If you ever find yourself in the area... DO STOP IN!!

* sucky parking expensive prices good dessert * Drip Affogato Bar is located in the Central Business District of New Orleans, which mainly means that finding parking around here will likely be both hard and expensive. And because Drip is such a bougie place, the prices match the expensive aesthetic of the CBD and the vibe that Drip gives off. I think the price is worth it, at least to try it once because it's pretty good! It's a good place to go to for a celebration or fancy event. I LOVE this affogato bar, it's just a slight hassle to get here & also takes a slight hit to my bank account each time.

I have several Dunkin's near me and this is my favorite one to go to. The staff is always cheerful, nice and helpful. It's never crowded which is nice even though it's located in A busy area of center city. The food is given to you quickly and the longest I've waited was probably about 2 minutes. It's kept clean which I appreciate since the one about 2 blocks is not. The food is standard Dunkin' quality so I don't expect anything out of this world. What really keeps me coming back is how friendly everyone is.

Been to this Starbucks almost every day this past week. Good Service and the drinks are made just the way they should be and within a reasonable amount of time. Overall it was a very average Starbucks experience for me which isn't to say that it's bad, it's not. I'm just satisfied with the service I received here.

What an interesting concept! This little doughnut shop is actually a mini doughnut factory. As soon as you walk in, you are greeted by a sweet smell and smile. You can actually see your doughnuts being made after ordering. I got a 6 pack which include the anti-filled, Boston kreme, Homer Simpson, birthday cake, rice Krispy, and french toast. You can either order off their menu of doughnuts or create your own with the different toppings. My favorite was the French toast. I devoured each doughnut in two bites. I liked the somewhat crunchiness on the exterior of the doughnut. I will definitely be back when I'm craving a sweet treat!

Had a large party and they accommodated well. Tried the boudin balls and they were great and full of flavor. The gumbo was very good with good flavor and spice but lacked in quantity of meat and seafood, however we came in toward the end of the day so they might have been running low on gumbo. The shrimp and mango salad was excellent and fresh and had a large number of shrimp. Would definitely come back.

It was such a pleasant breakfast experience! Good food, good service, and good company. The restaurant is quaint & the menu is limited but packed with the essentials. Crystal was our waitress & she did a very nice job. The experience was overall a good one & if/when we're in the are, we'd surely take a trip back!

My husband and I ordered the Rockafellar oysters. They were absolutely amazing! I wish we had ordered more. The spinach on top was perfectly seasoned. My husband ordered the pasta jambalaya and he said it was the best he's had. I decided on the bayou platter. It wasn't bad, but I wish that I had chosen something else. The customer service was pretty good. We were seated as soon as we walked in and our order was taken once we were ready! Next time we're in New Orleans we'll definitely go back.
First of all, Louis Armstrong was not actually here. But check in was quick and relatively painless (was only bitten twice by TSA zombies) and there was a solid selection of food.

I came here for dinner and drinks with a few friends after work during the week. We ordered cocktails which of course were fantastic as I've heard this is one of the best cocktail bars in town. Each of us ordered a few snacks, I ordered the cheese curds and brown butter biscuits. The cheese curds has great flavor I mean who doesn't love fried cheese?! The brown butter biscuits were delicious but the portion size was teeny tiny for the price. That seemed to be the consensus of the group that while their food is delicious it's expensive and you may leave hungry. Will definitely be back though for an early evening happy hour.

Finally tried this small (16 seats)family owned restaurant. You feel like you are in family home. My veggie scramble was delicious and my husband said the Blind Dog coffee was VERY good. The western decor accompanied by the old fashioned country music provided a little respite from busy city life.

Business trip - Glorious bedding, decent gym, cookies at check-in, ice cream when we returned from dinner (at Vine & Stein 5 star!), UNBELIEVABLE hot shower pressure, peacock wandering grounds, hot breakfast & spectacular night desk management. Good luck with your delivery!

what a cool experience! The only reason I'm giving this 4 and not 5 was because I went in January where there is little gator activity. We saw some though! and also different types of birds, and turtles, and of coarse the swamp itself was amazing! Although New Orleans is a great place, this was a nice escape from the city for a few hours... hope to go back in the summer sometime :)

This is a lovely place to do work--beautiful airy atmosphere inside with lots of individual tables, as well as a large seating area outside with both sunny and shady sections. The oatmeal chocolate chip cookies were fantastic. My iced chai latte was a little watery, though.

Ok, the only reason this did not get a 5 star is because I hand wrote the chef a letter pleading with him on how he made his scallops in a corn chowder reduction. I used to eat at this place 1x a week. Every time, this dish. I would actually awake at night thinking about this. The best flavors I have ever tasted. Their business man lunch is a real bargain. I always get the pulled pork/beef bbq.

Went to Lolli's for some Mother's Day gifts. Their chocolates are quite tasty. Also, I put together some boxes for various mothers and the cost wasn't too bad. Very reasonable. Also, they have day old chocolates and past holiday chocolates that are a lower price. Great place to go and better parking than Blue Frog.

LOVED the theme this year. The floats were amazing and the riders were pretty generous with the throws. Really, the only bad thing was the weather - but even with that, Tucks was able to move their start time up by an hour or two, hoping to beat the worst of the storm. It started raining a little early on, but we stuck around, and I'm glad we did. The baby had a great time, as did the adults. Tucks definitely beats a lot of the "smaller" daytime parades. We almost went to the westbank parade instead, so that we could escape the poor weather a bit quicker... but I'm glad we went uptown.

What a great place to bike to in the eagle area. A friend of mine introduced me to this place and I loved it! They have an amazing bakery for breakfast and delicious burgers for lunch. Workers were very nice. Definitely will return
Was pretty decent - the food lacked some salt and pepper otherwise the service was quick

SO GOOD, but PREPARE TO BE POOR AFTER A MEAL HERE! Def avoid like THE PLAGUE from 12 to about 1:30. Yes, you will reek of expensive, organic ingredients pressed in a panini-presser but so what? You'll smell better than having gorged yourself at one of those Indian buffets nearby. Despite the price, you do get a lot of food. Plus, it's organic and healthy. You pay for fantastic quality and the dressings are AMAZING.

It's not a 5 star restaurant but it's good enough for a hospital. My parents and I usually went here after my chemotherapy and radiation treatments until I got too sick that I couldn't keep solid food down. It was tasty 5 years ago so I figure it's just as tasty now. It is a little expensive but like I typed, it's hospital food. It's not going to be cheap.

Always a dope spot to get boba! Definitely the most traffic boba spot in Chinatown but on this Thursday night looks like no one was home haha! The warm HK Coffee/tea w/ boba was an interesting combo ... that I'm not sure was on the menu ... but when I asked for coffee + boba this is what I got.
Got a deal through Hotwire and so happy I did. Great hotel, GREAT staff. Sweet rooms, super bar tender and the staff's suggestion for breakfast at Green Eggs Cafe ROCKED.
5 for the dessert (bread pudding - dang) 4 lunch special (soup and veggie sandwich) 3 service (could have been much better - slow and not that helpful)
More interesting is deck fresh air , weekend life music , delicious burger , some brewery different beer...

Yes! A healthy juice place that is convenient and easy to order and pay using an app on my phone. It's not going to be for everyone - but if you are into juicing it's a great place to visit. I can't vouch for the food / salads but the pre made juices are always fresh and tasty. It is a bit expensive, but for quality ingredients I think it's worth it.
YUM!!! after dinner at Luke we walked to this place. the Honey Lavender and pistachio are delicious!!!

Came here to try a something new and we weren't disappointed. The portions are huge and the food is good. My boyfriend had the chicken fried steak and said it's possibly the best he's had. The corn beef and hash omelet is amazing. The only thing we both weren't fans of were the potatoes. We will be back in the near future for sure

Conveniently located on the corner on Elliston Place. Have to be careful turning into the parking lot due to busy traffic. Don't let the hot sign cause you to have a wreck!! You can see the conveyor belt with fresh, tasty donuts from the drive thru window. Stop by for a yummy treat if you're coming to St. Thomas Midtown (old Baptist Hospital), one of the many doctor's offices in the area, or just passing by.

Had the down south for breakfast which was incredible. Eggs were cooked just like I asked. The crawfish etouffee was a little watery but the crawfish was fresh and spices were perfect. Cinnamon bun was delicious, would definitely get that again. Staff was very very nice and helpful. Free wifi too!
Great location and really cool vibe! *Don't get a soy latte, I did not dig it. Everything else is great with soy!

My husband and I found this on yelp and loved the central location to everything in downtown. It is reasonably priced and includes parking. The decor of the place was so neat and it made us feel at home. Our favorite part of the place we're the large windows that opened up to a beautiful central skyline view of the city. It would have been five stars it if it had a balcony lol Other than that this place is really clean, private and easy to park.

(3.75) ~ Good Overall Natural Foods Grocery Store. Note: It's similar to Whole Foods, but with a greater emphasis on Plant Based Products and less meat. Pretty good selection of supplements for a Grocery store. And the star of the show is their Produce section;)
I would love to have more check ins but City Garden isn't on the rotation much anymore. Makes me sad:(

They make it the way I like it - strong! (usually get the Red Eye). Convenient location right at the Streetcar stop on 4th Ave & 5th St. Reasonable prices. Easy in and out when in a hurry. Nice little coffee shop that will be even better when the patio is done.

Great food and nice servers. It's not the greatest place for ambiance but as far as food goes YUMMY! I had the crawfish étouffée and it was excellent. Lots of food great sauce, bunches of crawfish and nice spice.

I really enjoyed their pralines. I also tried a white chocolate turtle which wasn't bad either. I'd chose Southern Candy Makers pralines to enjoy in New Orleans and bring back the packaged Aunt Sally's as they may travel better being they are boxed. These were definitely one of my favorites over Magnolia and Leah's Pralines.

A little hole in the wall place in walking distance of my Air BNB in Compton Heights. I loved that it was so close, and the neighborhood was so lovely! Lona's Lil Eats had delicious, healthy food. I went for the Steak Wrap and Spicy Eggplant. Everything was super yummy! And the Ginger Molasses cookie was just what I needed to top off dinner!

Fun place to come with friends, they have more lanes than any other bowling alley that I have been to and they have a separate room with a bar and dart boards that does dart nights with groups. The drinks are average priced and they have some food to purchase. It can get pretty busy on weekends, including if school is in and I like that they are open late.

Honestly, who would have thought that hot dogs and donuts would actually taste good together?! It's an interesting idea and it works well here. Loves: + elote loco is the most popular and duh, bc it's good + stairway 2 heaven and dirty churro are best donuts + space is cute bc it's a converted house to shop + cool staff who get that you might take 2349802 years to order ;) I came here due to a recommendation from a local and it was worth it. Not to mention, our visit here was super special because we got some comp'd beers. So YAY!!! What a great time. :)
Love this place but it does get crowded and parking can be a bit of a pain. However the food is amazing. Love to come blow paychecks on amazing food.
Great casual seafood joint with good specials and good food. Prices are good for the location

First off, Kennett Square (where?!) is a little hidden gem - and by little I mean 2x2 blocks. It's a weird blend of small-town-in-boonies and hipster, and it works. Philter is a down-to-earth coffee shop in the middle of the main road. Spacious interior and very friendly staff. Along with the aroma of pastries that fill the shop, you can smell the Ceremony beans in all their glory as you enter. Can't go wrong with the lattes, and I suggest sipping it in the small seating area outside for some good people-watching.

As an out of towner, this is where I went first to try a Philly cheesesteak. Watching the process passed the time while waiting in line. If there's this much discussion about which institution is better, they all must be fairly good.
Great time at The Saint Phillip French Quarter Apartments during Mardi Gras 2015. We were in walking distance to all the festivities. The staff was very helpful.

Great fresh Mexican. Loved the specials: we had chile relleno stuffed with crab and enchiladas stuffed with halibut and prawns -- a great twist where the local fresh seafood is so abundant. They had all the usual items you expect to see on the menu; the service was very good and the margaritas were superb! They use a premium Patron tequila in the margaritas and it shows.

I am updating this review. I hate actually providing a negative review and really only do so when the situation calls for it. I also believe in second chances - so I decided to hit Fuzzy's for breakfast as I was in the area and am happy to provide some further insight. I can report this visit was far better than the last. The staff were courteous and efficient in getting my order done. The food was very good. I had two burritos (one chorizo and the other bacon) and a side of potatoes. This was a carry out order but for those looking to dine in, the restaurant is attractively decorated and has outside seating.

One of my favorite spots to do work. High quality coffee, nice variety of brunch options (served all day) The only downside is that the wifi isn't always the greatest and it takes them awhile to make drinks sometimes.
Nice outside patio, great atmosphere, awesome drink menu, nice attentive servers, music is way too loud, very hard to have a conversation. Will sit outside next time.

This is an exquisite place to have a drink. Quite a mixture of such liquids that make me feel like I don't even know my own language, i.e. "Amaro sfumato, amaro nonino, lambert de seyssel, brut NV. Port glass"..... yeah whatever that is. It was decent. More importantly- there is a record player in the bathroom. You can choose your own record. Great place to take a peaceful dump. Nice work gang.

The food is fabulous. The house margaritas are really good. the beer is cold. the salsa is so good. The prices are right. The staff is fun and flirty with the ladies. I wish I could move it closer to my home.

In the heart of downtown Narberth with a lovely outdoor seating area, this is a great place to grab a tasty ice cream cone, no matter the season. It's great that they always have at least two dairy free options and one or two sorbets. For a small shop, their ice cream assortment is pretty impressive. My current favorite? Butter pecan!

What can you expect for 50 cents? There's a stop at every block, drops me off exactly where I need to be, don't have to find parking, saves on tired legs, don't have to navigate busy sidewalks. What more could I ask for this price?! The down sides: the slight wait...we waited 20 minutes when we first got on, then 10 for the return trip. Also, shuttles can get packed and you might have to stand or wait for the next one.

What a fabulously adorable breakfast spot! Although the restaurant is situated in a less than stellar looking strip mall, do not let this deter you from from visiting! I have enjoyed various items from their morning menu, but the breakfast burrito, pancakes, and potatoes stand out in my mind. While you can call ahead to order for takeout, I ordered at the drive-thru last week and was pleased with the quick service. The cashiers are using masks and gloves due to COVID-19, which I appreciate.

I really grew to enjoy Fat Straw when it was around, and I will miss the chance to get bubble tea every now and then. That being said, it's pretty good for gelato. Gelato is generally a little heavier than ice cream, and it's usually smoother. I would say that they seem to go just a little overboard with the flavors, but I had the coconut, and it was great.
Cute cafe. Very nice employees. I recommend this place! Mainly bc its close to home for me, but great quality.
Nice work Tampa! Your airport is clean, convenient, has lots of shopping, hotels on sight and even live music. Thanks for making your airport not seem like at airport.

Lox omelet could have been good, but I ate first half wondering where the cream cheese was, only to discover at least a half block of cheese was dumped on the other end. Jay's bacon Benedict was excellent. Huge serving a fruit looked beautiful on the plate but something they had cleaned the grapes with causes a strange reaction on my tongue, and did the same to Jay. Made it feel like it was burned, and very dry mouth.

Cool atmosphere and fun goodies. We ordered two smoothies which were very tasty. The chocolate banana one was oh so good. The strawberry banana one was very refreshing. They have yogurt toward the back, you grab your own cup and it was creamy and tasted great. The ultimate treat was the açaí bowl filled with a smoothie, fresh fruit, grAnola, and drizzled with sweetened condensed milk. Wow, can I lick the bowl? The store sits on a great ppl watching street. They have window seats that makes that all possible. Really fun place to take a break.

Food is absolutely delicious, especially the crawfish etouffe and bread pudding. This is a must stop for me when visiting. The only downfall is the staff. They can be very rude and uninterested in your needs, probably because patrons are not allowed to tip. Don't let this deter you from the food.

(4.5) Can't recall eating a better Acai bowl in the last 6 months. I really appreciate being able to get every ingredient in every bite, which is surprisingly not easily done with most Acai bowls. Tried the Classic with almond butter, coconut, honey, and strawberries + the Rainbow with Nutella.

We started the 4 part cooking class in the event space. The chef was awesome and allowed us plenty of time to practice and create our own dishes to eat and take home. We are looking forward to the next sessions which include vegetables, meats and the final week of working in a group to create your own meal.

The pluses: Good sized dining room. Great, friendly staff. Great outdoor seating. Close to downtown. And it's frequented by many of my friends (I know you don't care)! The negatives: Parking is difficult (Small for several businesses). It's so busy that it frequently feels messy. No drive-thru. Not my fav St. Pete Starbucks, but not a bad choice if you're on that side of town.

I almost want to give this place 5 stars, it's tough not to. I just think there needs to be better toppings and a little more of a selection to choose from. Also, the seating could be more comfortable , but it's a dive in type place and people are in and out all day sweating so it's probably a good idea not to have back rest on the chairs.
Absolutely amazing pizza and apps!!! Will be coming back! Love the atmosphere and the service was amazing

This cafe looks very nice from the outside and the interior is nice too. I was pleasantly surprised by how good the bagel breakfast sandwich was. Very filling and felt healthy. Latte was also quite good, but the tea selection is lousy.
Perfect size airport. Friendly service and easy security process. Easy for drop off and pickups. Very limited food options and no lounge.
Great local butcher shop with some awesome german imports and meats... Their bacon and kielbasa are worth a try as well...

Love the atmosphere on the inside. The staff is so welcoming and polite. I had the pleasure of tasting Chongqing hot pepper chicken ($11) and Fish fillet with hot pepper ($14)..... LOVED IT! Price can be a little high but they do offer a lunch menu (11am-3pm weekdays) that is very reasonable. If you have it spend it because it's worth it and they give u a nice portion size. So if you are in the area I recommend taking a moment to enjoy and if you like spicy food I recommend Chongqing hot pepper chicken ($11)!

Best Halibut I have Ever had!!!! I even took it back to my hotel room thinking I'd find a way to eat it!!! Had to eventually come to terms with having to throw it out before my room got stinky. =( There wasn't anything I ordered that I wasn't AMAZED with! Was on the phone with my best friend telling her how much I wished she had come on my business trip with me so she could have tried it! Tried replicating it, or finding restaurants to replicate it and nothing has come close to it yet...

If your debating taking one of the voodoo, haunted, or vampire tours in New Orleans come here the night before. Almost all of them stop here for a watering hole. It will give you a chance to talk to the people on all the tours and pick one based on their observations. The do make one of the best hurricanes in NOLA as well. Lots of history to see in this town. And one of the last cool spots on Bourbon Street.

If you're looking for top notch fried or boiled seafood Salvo's is the place you want to go. They have a very casual and homey atmosphere along with friendly service. Prices are very reasonable especially for the amount of food that you get. That being said, you may want to show up early because it gets crowded pretty quick (partially because Belle Chasse isn't exactly known for great restaurants). If it's on a Friday during Lent you will surely be better off phoning your order in and picking it up to eat elsewhere (unless you have plenty of time on your hands and don't show up too hungry)

This was definitely worth the wait in line. Parking is a bit of a challenge, but again worth the hassle. The breakfast burrito was delicious! Coffee super yummy. Great service. Definitely recommend this place. I can see why there were voted #53 in the top 100 places to eat in America in 2020 by Yelp!! Congrats! Yum!
Great food (yes, the accolades we heard about the tacos were true!), but the service was "iffy" and slow. Not so "iffy" where I wouldn't go back tho!!
I highly recommend the spicy mocha. The barista was courteous and the blueberry muffin was awesome. Glad to see places like this popping up on the west side. They've earned my business.

The staff was very friendly and helpful. I really liked how clean the store was. They take pride in this grocery store. Everything is well organized and easy to find. They have a great selection of craft beers for a very reasonable price. Overall I was very impressed with this store and decently will return.

I like this coffee shop a whole lot and it has great seating areas. My only hesitation is that the staff wear masks too infrequently, and the patrons seem to not realize we're in the midst of a pandemic. I feel unsafe only for those reasons. The food is good.
I'm a fan of the rocky movies, so while visiting Philly, of course I had to run up the rocky steps and check out the rocky statue. The rocky statue is located near the bottom of the steps.

Thank you for the great cup of coffee. I travel a lot and always look for the local roasters. Found this one and walked over from my hotel so I didn't have to drink hotel coffee this morning. Great cup of coffee! Staff was friendly and service was quick. Clean seating outside to enjoy downtown. Come try this place if you are staying downtown.

A plethora of food items to choose from in this food hall. You can have your dinner and dessert all in one place which I find very convenient. It's a very big touristy place to go to (which a tourist like me) had a good time at. I didn't get to try one of the vendors which had 'worlds oldest ice cream' but I'll make sure to go back and try it one day.

Man, what a huge posh bar and restaurant! I only had drinks the night before the Philly Marathon, but the menu looked good. They didn't have Blue Curacao for my Gulf Coast martini, but they made an alternative that was fine. Pretty pricey, but I expected as much from the amazing interior.

Rooms are very nice updated and clean. The bed was very soft and comfortable beds. Great water pressure but drains ran slow as heck. Stood ankle deep in water by time I got done in shower. The morning and happy hour buffet was very good. Lots of options for everyone and 3 free adult beverages per night (nice suprise), free popcorn and pop all night. Was there for a Barnes visit and they give discounts if you mention that and it was very close to the hospital too.

I happen to live in Pennsport, and this place has been slipping my mind recently. I don't know why, it just has. I had been here a handful of times, and recently returned. Good beer selection, late night happy hour, and a pool table and darts. They didn't even get mad when one memeber of our party literally threw every dart into the chalk board backboard (by accident of course!). Pleasant enough atmosphere, and the food is pretty good as well. Burger and wing specials on Wednesday nights. I am going to try and frequent this spot more often!

This is an affordable decent hotel located centrally to all the main venues such as Jackson square, bourbon street, and cafe du monde is only a few blocks away. I booked the interior room without a window and it actually wasn't too bad. The room was a decent size, came with an in room safe, 4 lamps, and the bathroom was also updated. My only complaint were the pillows were a bit stiff or maybe I just weren't used to the pillows since they made my shoulders ache after a few nights rest there. All in all, I would stay here again if I visit new orleans.

Great hotel! What a pleasant surprise to find in the heart of Philly. Excellent location with plenty of stores, restaurant, pretzels, and activities nearby. The hotel was a fun quaint little place,with good coffee gratis in the lobby, converted from a bank so rooms were interesting. From the front desk to housekeeping, the staff was smiling, helpful, and quietly efficient. The happy hour in the lounge was a fun time where our group met and shared delicious complimentary tapas with our tasty cocktails. Novios restaurant next door looked fabulous with a great menu and deserved reputation and 4 star rating...can't wait to try next time. When you are in Philadelphia we highly recommend that you stay at Club Quarters.
The cioppino is incredible with tons on garlic. Veggies should be careful as there are pieces of ham in it. The steamed mussels was awesome as an appetizer.

This food is on point. Some of the best tacos I have ever had. I don't normally like corn tortillas, but these ones were super light and delicate. It's a small building and in disrepair, buts all about the food. I'll get better at these reviews, but in short : Unassuming hole in the wall with great authentic food.

This place is awesome. We visited as part of the brewery tour and left so satisfied. Try everything but maybe not the graham cracker vanilla stout (good until half way through) sours were tasty, IPAs typically delicious , and the paradise park was perfect. Fun entertaining brewery that needs to get in my beer distributor soon!

The beignets are light and deliciously airy. The coffee rich and full bodied.... Definitely much better than Café Du Monde, (disclaimer) in my opinion. Skip the tourist trap, and instead, go to the mom 'n pop shop around the corner.

On the western border of university city, Lee's Deli is a neighborhood institution. Their sandwiches and the house-made deserts are something to behold. When you stop by Lee's you'll enjoy generous portions and a very friendly staff who is more than happy to make recommendations. When the staff found out it was our first time there, they treated us to complementary carrot cake. They are very vegetarian friendly and feature two meatless cheesesteaks, both of which are delicious. I like the seitan cheesesteak a bit better than the black bean, but they're both quite good. The regular cheesesteak is amazing and tasted just as good the next day.
The staff were truly very great and friendly. They offered recommendations and water every time we left the building. Really very nice and location is fairly central to everything!

My favorite coffeehouse in Tampa, hands-down! It has such a warm atmosphere, it makes you feel right at home each time you walk through the door! It's hard to go anywhere else after having their coffee and kick myself when I try.
What a beautiful place to have lunch. The food is fresh and simply amazing. I cannot get enough of that hibiscus tea it's so refreshing

All the coffee is delightful and not just anyone can nail an almond milk latte the way Coffeebar does. The food items are always delicious, and if you're feeling a little sweet I highly recommend the Giuseppe bar.

The dinner menu is subtle, intelligent, sophisticated, and bold. There is an awesome attention to detail in each meal, it's exciting. Plus everyone is very friendly, and they let you have a leisurely time, great service.

Awesome French bakery! This place was perfect for breakfast and is in a little shopping plaza with some great stores if you have to wait for a table. You'll want to plan on taking extra pastries home :)
They have a great Tuesday BOGO 50% off for Pad Thai. Clean location and quick service. I would consider this a quick casual restaurant.

Love this spot. Very modest looking from the outside, but inside it's cozy,colorful, and most importantly the food is delicious. We've been back four or five times and the quality is consistent. If you want a locals recommendation on an Indian spot, come here! My favorites are the tandoori chicken and tikka masala. Soooo yummy!!

Had a great iced coffee and absolutely perfect apple tart here. This location is right across the street from the Liberty Bell, so it's a great spot to relax in after walking around. Service was friendly and there are plenty of places to sit, plus free still and sparkling water on top.
Great restaurant. Staff, from the bartenders to the wait staff are outstanding. I highly recommend this establishment.

After attending the Penn State prospects camp with my son,we traveled here later that night. We stayed overnight here to shop in Philadelphia for the daytime! Located in Center City this place is posh! It's strategically located for plenty of restaurant visits and shopping. If your an Eagles fan its not far from the arena. They have a snack bar that is over priced as many hotels are. The rooms facing the city streets are stunning! I highly recommend you stay here if possible. All the staff including the Valet were awesome.
Great breakfast experience! Great treat for the kids. Loved their service and food all around 5 stars!! Bob Evans has the best pancakes, if you're new to Bob Evans be sure to give them a try!!

My partner and I had a fantastic two-day stay here! The room was cozy and pleasant, the bed was comfortable, and the view was excellent. Two particular staff members stand out; Annette and Milton. Annette answered our room charge questions when I was panicked at 1 in the morning, and explained them to great clarity. When the next day, we had to change rooms (due to a sudden need for a second stay), Milton found a way to allow us to keep the room we had instead of having to check out and in again. We were very grateful for all the assistance, and would absolutely stay here again!
Great place - the staff is super friendly and knowledgable about the teas. And the açaí bowls are delicious. We will definitely be back!

I love this place!! The guys who work there are so nice and very helpful!! The store is nice and open and someone is always there to help. They are not pushy and will give you honest opinions. One of the guys let me try a protein shake flavor before I bought it and then gave me and a friend a free tshirt since we are moving out of the city. They will also ship to you!! They have very comparable prices and they won't lead you astray. I'm a huge fun! Definitely check them out :)

This is hands down the best pretzel place in the Philly area. They've been a staple in our family my whole life. The customer service is always great and the pretzels are delicious. If you're a fan of porkroll, you've got to try the porkroll and american cheese on a pretzel. So good!

Aldi's definitely has the best prices in town for groceries! They are all Aldi's own brand but are just as good quality as publix or Walmart! You have to bring your own bags or pay 10 cents each for theirs. Also bring a quarter to get a cart and when you bring it back you get your quarter back. I definitely recommend this store, although it could use some background music!

I spent 12 dollars for enough food to feed a party. 30+ warm tortillas, a bag of chips, and 2 salsas. The tortillas will make you want to never EVER buy them from the grocery store again. So worth the headache of trying to park in the Italian market on a Saturday.

Excellent cafe latte prepared by a friendly and competent barista. Really relaxing outdoor seating in the super interesting and quaint MSA Annex. Come for the caffeine, stay for the unique shopping experience

OMG Piekutowski's is still around...I remember going there as a child and Benny, the one butcher, would talk to my grandmother & dad in Polish. The lady behind the counter would always give my brother and I a slice of the fresh hard crust bread to eat. I remember when my grandmother would get her Krakow for Easter and would take it the Saturday before Easter to St. Stanislaus and have her Easter food blessed. What wonderful memories.

Came here for a date night with my hubby n we are from NYC. He had the filet mignon that melted in your mouth. I had their special seafood home made pasta in white wine sauce. Oh geez that was delicious. We also finished with Trees Leche cake. Just as good as their sister restaurant MADERA. Diego our server was great. He recommended an awesome Malbec wine. If only we lived closer.

I have been to Caffe Nation on Valencia easily over 30 times over the past year. Two co-workers and I first went there when the line at the place next door was out the door and we had a limited time for lunch. We have not been back to the other location since. Caffe Nation is a great place to eat. Their menu is extensive without being overly big and their staff are always friendly. We can always get in and out of there with plenty of time to spare if we have a limited amount of time for lunch.
The only word to describe this place is amazing! You can create your own donut or pick one they've already created, no matter what you choose they will be delicious!

I have been amazed at how welcoming this neighborhood coffee shop has become. The coffee drinks were always good, but I haven't been in for quite awhile since we lived only a few blocks away. But yesterday day we went in for a cup of coffee and a snack about mid-morning. I was surprised at how many people were there. It has become quite a gathering place. There was still plenty of place to sit. They have comfy arm chairs, standard tables and chair, and outdoor seating. Good for those walking their dogs. Brewed coffees, smoothies, espressos, Italian ices, and more are offered. Pastries by Gaston were offered. Good for a visit with friends and leisurely passing the time.

Various tour options. Tons to see. Occasional shows, and a free photo of you on the stage with any ticket. All five of.our group got a photo so we had a full group and a mish mash of other groupings. So much to see and plenty of time. Lots of sanitizer stations and a great little gift shop. Center of the known strip and lots of parking nearby. This is a spot you have to visit in Nashville when you are there.
Delicious! A fantastic way to cool off in Tucson and beat the heat. I recommend the mango slush with boba.
Great customer service with an excellent product! Nobody does it like the Human Bean! This is my go-to for hot and cold drinks.

I went to Volo Coffeehouse for the first time yesterday, after doing a search for places with good coffee where you can get work done. Volo popped right up. Free wi-fi (worked perfectly for 4 hours), the coffee is AMAZING (drank 2 lattes while there), had a prosciutto sandwich that took me right back to when I was living in Rome, and the staff was quick and friendly. If you're looking for a regular coffee place in Manayunk, this is it.

This is a great parade! They throw well. My little nephew got a number of cool throws and I didn't see anything dangerous like whole, unopened bags of beads being thrown (I'm looking at you, Endymion). Furthermore, It was fairly easy to get a good spot for the parade. Plus, there was plenty to look at and enjoy. The floats were pretty and there were a number of cool bands and groups marching with them. The 610 Stompers! The St. Augustine Marching 100! There were any number of fun sub-groups. There was a dance group with a mermaid theme and cool jellyfish lights and the Try Athletes with their be-lighted adult tricycles. Such fun!

This hotel is amazing!!! Beautiful courtyard, sweet staff and affordable for being about 30 feet from bourbon street. If you are looking for a posh, upscale hotel, go stay at the Astor or 4 seasons. If you want a romantic, cozy, quaint and historic hotel, this is the place to be. We stayed in the creole cottage and I was taken aback by its beauty and charm. The staff was also so sweet. When we told them it was our anniversary they brought us a box of chocolates.

You'll have a great time! My wife and I opted for the 2 hour butterfly beach tour. Tim was our guide. Very friendly and knowledgeable, he gave us tour of the beach and surrounding area. Segways are fun, and you are trained well enough to operate it. By the time it was over I was sad to part with it. Highly recommended, especially in an area as beautiful as Santa Barbara. Well worth the price of admission.

I had never heard of this place until I came here for a group meeting for college. I loved the look as soon as I walked in. It's a little small, and may fill up fast, but it's a great place for meetings, schoolwork, or just sipping coffee and enjoying the atmosphere. The staff was very friendly and helpful! I ordered their chai latte (hot) and it was the best I've had yet! Way better than Starbucks (sorry Starbucks!). For anyone who hasn't been here and plans to stay and enjoy their coffee, their wifi password is on the chalkboard next to the cash register. It can be hard to notice if you don't know where to look.

I've been to many zoos that cost money such as Brookfield Zoo in Illinois, Milwaukee Zoo in Wisconsin, and San Diego Zoo in California. This was by far my FAVORITE zoo. The architecture of the exhibits is designed so well! You can see the animals relatively close from many many different angles! Just have to pay for parking because the free parking spots were under construction! Thank you for a great experience! Visited in December 2016

Delicious ice cream, was really impressed. The ice cream is very rich and tastes delicious and like nothing I've ever had before. The staff was super friendly and the atmosphere was great, will definitely be coming back here again. I had the cookies and cream and the munchies and they were both delicious, my boyfriend is obsessed with this place too. You must try it!

A cozy, quaint coffee lounge with a great selection of craft espresso drinks! I ordered the coffee flight and my boyfriend ordered the bye bye blackbird, and we both got the sausage, egg, and cheese breakfast sandwich! I really enjoyed the option of trying various espresso's, and the bye bye blackbird was wonderful! Although, I would have to say the sandwiches were just "ok". The ambiance is on point...low-key coffee lounge music (talk about a vibe!), plenty of table and couch seating, lights dimmed just enough to set a chill mood, and not loud overly-busy chatter from other patrons...and we were there at 930AM on a Sunday morning! Definitely a must-go if you're in town!

Always the best of everything! Thanks Vince for ordering my stuffed peppers special, and always providing the best customer service and highest quality products that takes me back to my Italian childhood.
This ace is amazing. The strawberry, banana, Nutella crepe was giant and fantastic. The vanilla latte was even superior. Very sweet and tasty. I'll an to come back every time I'm in St. Louis.

Probably one of my favorite beer experiences. Pro's: 1) The pale ale I ordered was fantastic. It's rare that I'll drink a beer and be impressed by how flavorful and aromatic it is, but that was certainly the case. 2) The people, both patrons and servers. There were families there with babies, dogs, etc. And, no college/club type crowds. Very pleasant atmosphere. 3) The food truck was a welcome treat, and contributed to the outdoor feel of the place. Con's 1) The neighborhood is a bit intimidating if you're not familiar with the area. We parked a couple of blocks away.

My review is based upon the hospitality and help I received from this amazing Holiday Inn. I was here for 4 nights due to a family medical emergency - the staff went above and beyond to check on me, made sure I had transportation to Vanderbilt Hospital if I wasn't up for the short walk, and every morning asked how my loved one was doing. I had a room which was quiet, clean, and stacked with quality shower products. Nice perk with a microwave and mini fridge but the bed and pillows provided just what I needed after stress fulled days. When the chips are down, kindness goes a long way. Thank you Holiday Day Nashville-Vanderbilt...

This is a gorgeous restaurant! I had a dinner last night with my two Japanese colleague and both of them love it! The beer, appetizers, yakitori and ramen are all very authentic and delicious. I am very satisfied with the great food and service.

I love cc simply because of their hours. So instead of ppl making coffee shops feel like shh shh libraries, you can feel free to do that at say anytime of the day. I get so much studying done in the wee hours of the night. Comfy. I have always picked off of my boyfriends sandwiches here, sorry when I study I'm on a roll and not focused on eating lol. Love the ambiance and chai latte...mmm

As a self proclaimed wine geek, who has been on many tours, this was the most informative I have ever been on. The spirits are also amazing. Well worth the price. The Groupon got us in there, the owner James, kept us with his knowledge. Can't wait for the Rum t ok be available.

Paige and her family go that extra mile to make sure all of your travel arrangements and accommodations are to your specifications. I have done a trip to Alaska and my trip and excursions were above my expectations. They cater to all of your needs and they stay on top of all the great vacation spots and get the best deals on airlines and hotels. They definitely will get my next vacation

Wow, this place is a gem!! A beautiful little shotgun on a quiet corner in the Treme. Great coffee, delicious pastries, and absolutely scrumptious Mediterranean breakfast! I went with the family, so we sat in the front room and chatted, but there was also a very quiet back room that would be ideal for studying and sipping coffee.

My friend and I were complaning about how it was hard to find simple healthy food out in Philly, and then lo and behold we walked by Pure Fare! The food was delicious, the staff was helpful, the aesthetic was lovely. It's often almost empty for dinner so they don't have pre-made stuff, which was fine by us! We sat down at the long table in the middle of the room and played on the floaty chairs and chatted while we waited. Will definitely be returning. Like, tonight!

Oh yeah! I'm talking about 'the fish market' at Kona Jack's. Where in Indiana can you go and trust that the seafood was swimming the day before. I do here! The reviews that speak of over priced in the restaurant, maybe so. -- try buying your own and preparing it in your own home. Call and ask what came in that morning. There are a couple of places that I think you can trust the fish monger's dates on seafood in the city and there are many that you can't. -just do the research!

First time having authentic Szechwan style food. The service was great, but the food - the food - was fantastic. I love mapo tofu, and this is hands down the best mapo tofu I've ever had. The spice level was perfect, and we had huge chunks of yummy tofu. We also ordered the stir fry chicken with jalapeños and chili peppers - this chicken had a great smoky flavor, perfect crispy sear, and it was delicious. Portion sizes were perfect, and we had tons of leftovers to take home!

Found this cozy gem of a restaurant while visiting the city...absolutely loved my breakfast..coffee was great..not the same old same old...breakfast hash was outstanding and service was quick and very friendly. Great little spot!
Nice little family run business. Bagels were really good. They were really generous with the cream cheese, more than I prefer, but that was fixable. Donuts were excellent too.
This is now closed , will reopen as a carry out Jewish style deli. Stay tuned for more info!

Great beer. Love their cubano, smoked chicken wings, and jalapeño ranch salad dressing. Kindest, most attentive folks working there. They have even held our fussy baby so we could eat our lunch. I love this place!

So we found out about this place on Man vs Food so when weren't to Philly we obviously had to try it. My daughter was all about the Mt Vesuvius and since it's quite large, I shared with her. It was AMAZING! Honestly, I could have finished the whole thing on my own. Hubby had the mint chocolate chip and he says it's the best ever. Great service and amazing ice cream.

I have a bee favorite restaurant! They make the wine, and it was so good!! I had a flight of 4 so I could try some different wines. Their fruit wines are so good and not too sweet! My favorite was the green apple. We ordered a cauliflower crust pizza. It's so hard to find good gluten free pizza. It was fluffy and sooooo good!! I ate way too much!! The owners served us. They were so friendly and welcoming!! You have to try this place if you are in the Virginia Square area!!!
