By far the best donuts I have ever had. Fresh, natural ingredients and the taste....simply wow. Favorite is the blueberry fritter. Apple fritter is close second Line moves quickly and everyone is very friendly. Been there three times during my conference and keep going back to those blueberry fritters... Soft with the right amount of chew and sublime taste. Totally worth the 95 cents for a donut !!!! I would pay 5$ for one of those!!

The owners are extremely kind and the food is delicious! I ordered a juicy fruit juice and sweet panini. The atmosphere has a lot of good vibes with great music playing in the background which adds to the ambiance. I'll be returning soon and highly recommend The Juice Bar!!!

YAY! They're on Caviar! I can still get my scone/cookie/chocolate fix during "COVID lock-down"! They're baking to order, which means I got warm scones. Perfection. (I did a pick-up at store -- they have a doorbell.) A.G.'s exceptional goodies honestly do help ease the stress of the quarantine doldrums.
My go to coffee in philly. Started buying it at whole foods. French press it at home. Fantastic! The owner is so about quality. Thanks!

I went here for dinner on Wednesday to catch up with a friend and this place is so good! I got two tacos, both of which had very fresh ingredients and tasty sauces. I also got a pineapple margarita that was awesome! I definitely plan to return at some point!

We just stopped here on a whim as our original destination was Texas Road House next door and it was delicious and service was outstanding! Our waiter brought seafood bread as we were seated...so good. Waiter was very attentive despite being short handed and my sweet tea never ran dry. We tried a sample of gumbo, because no two are alike, and it was so good we got a bowl. Split a boil and an order of crab cakes for main dish and surprise....we got fried cheese sticks in the crab cake basket. I could hear the neighbors all raving about their food as well. Go eat here if you like cajun. food. Trust me, it's worth it!

I love this Starbucks... Probably one of the busiest in the Spanish Springs East Sparks area. Always friendly and never got my order wrong... Sometimes the sand which might be a bit cool but heck I just press on.. The team does their best and probably can use some LEAN Management, heck they are always awesome.

Our favorite area restaurant. The food is always freshly prepared and the atmosphere is unique. And BYOB. Friday night used to be pizza & hoagie night but now it's shawarma night. Take home the eggplant, chicken or London broil shawarma and you'll never go back to hoagies! In the summer you can bring your wine and dine on the front porch. Nothing like this in our area. Initially I was afraid I wouldn't enjoy Lebanese cuisine but along with the shawarmas my favorites are the lasagna and the eggplant & pasta. And Wadiha will make things extra spicy if you want.

We had the sweetest tour guide. I laugh because you walk in and they go 'Tada.. welcome to the distillery... Ok that's it what would you like to try'. Our bartender was in a mixing mood and we got to try out several different vodka drinks and some of the whiskey. I had to buy a bottle at the end of it coz it was just that good. I'm glad we happened to run into this place and walked inside.

Excellent customer service for Starbucks and this location. Even when uber busy, this store takes pride in making the customer happy. Small location, but nice high tables in the back for intimate conversations.
What an incredible experience!! Our tour guide was Eric and we got to hold the alligators!

The ocean house was amazing. From start to finish the service was impeccable! Lauren's warmth and professionalism was only exponentially improved by Yuri's responsive and quick service. Yuri's recommendation: the parpadelle main course with a jalapeño addition- a must! The only tiff was a bad attitude in the Bacara bar prior with a young waitress (Amanda?) Nonetheless, thank you Angela for a quick recovery and Lauren for an amazing evening. We will definitely be back! With friends!

Thank you for a wonderful experience! Our tour guide, Majd, was excellent and I highly recommend him! He was very knowledgeable, especially of Scripture (we had some great discussions!). We were so impressed with his ability to speak multiple languages and to all kinds of people everywhere we went. He knows everyone and they all seem to think very highly of him. Because we had been to Israel already a few times, he wanted to accommodate our wishes and for us to have a meaningful experience, so he provided options - all of which were excellent. We learned so much about our faith and grew to love Israel even more!

This place is great, you can stop by and have a drink of their many beers they have on tap. This place is dog friendly and they have outdoor seating. It can be hard to find parking on the street out front usually which you have to pay for but if you go one street don't usually you can find free parking. The beer is also very good

Fantastic gem!!! Breakfast skillet and strawberry/banana crepes are absolutely delicious. Greek salad is yummy; perfect for lunch. Irene is the sweetest human on Madeira Beach. Makes you feel like you are visiting family in Europe. We stop by weekly. Always a great experience. Highly recommend this restaurant to everyone.
Favorite bagel sandwich in old city. Fast and friendly service. Cafe also sells kinder bueno which is a real plus!

Amazingly fluffy and tasty kolaches. When you bite into them you taste the homemadeness instead of the prepackaged as with many breakfast places today. My go-to spot on the east side when I'm looking for something semi-quick.
Excellent tour, interesting runs, whiskeys, and liqueurs. Samples of local chocolate and pickles are available as well.

Great yummy food. Ordered the wonton soup and beef pho with tendon and it was so delicious. Tasted very fresh. We also ordered the crispy chicken appetizer with extra basil and that also was delicious. The spicy squid balls were so good with the sweet chili sauce. They also have bubble tea there too and their drinks are also delicious and perfectly sweetened. Can't wait to go again!

We had the shrimp, chicken and fish tacos. They were all great, but the fish were amazing. We noticed everyone coming in the restaurant got the soapas and so we went up and place another order. The chicken sopa was amazing. It's worth the stop.

A GREAT EXPERIENCE. I've done this twice now - 1st with girlfriends, 2nd with my husband, sister, and brother-in-law. Sal truly enjoys sharing his glass blowing expertise. He is a great teacher, very calm and patient. I think we are very lucky to have this opportunity in Santa Barbara. Thank you, Sal.
Great place for food and craft beer. Its artsy, fun, casual, and the food is excellent. I'd refer any pizza lover here!

It's always those tiny little holes in the wall where you discover something special, The menu is small and simple and they perfect the few menu items that they have. They definitely got a regular customer of me

Lunch here today. The lasagna was fantastic & spaghetti and meatballs amazing! What I enjoyed most was the salad--- not sure what they did to it but it was amazing! We will for sure visit here again! My hubby loved the bread dipping oil too!
Amazing! 2nd time trying this place during my 2nd visit to NOLA and definitely would come back... all good was delicious! Didn't take pictures of all the food but yum-o

Love EarthFare, the managment and especially the staff. Sales addre very good especially for quality. I'll only but my wings there and ground beef, soups and rotisserie chicken are very good. I'd live to see good staff stay around a longer however. Cheese area has some longevity but not meat area, and it is hard to keep good peeps who care and seem to have fun and like what they do. It feels like a neighborhood market.

Very authentic, always good quality ingredients. We typically order takeout, but they have a nice seating area in the back of the store as well. The burritos are my personal favorite, but have never had a bad meal here.

Very delicious, made from scratch recipes. Seriously some of the best food I have had in a long time. Get savory and sweet dishes and share with each other! We ordered an omelette with goat cheese apples and walnuts and the Dutch baby. Both were equally amazing but they really tasted so good when you had a savory bite followed by a sweet note. The staff was super friendly laid back and helpful. The chef came out to check on our drinks (Bloody Mary - yes. Order this) and our food. I highly recommend this place, you won't be disappointed great for small or bigger groups. PERFECT for brunch.
Excellent. Everything from their delicious breakfast to the baristas creations. Frequently get the platter breakfast. One of my favorite breakfast spots to eat.

This is the greatest hotel ever!!! The hotel is gorgeous, it has an vintage vibe but still very modern. If you can stay in the executive suite. The bathroom is to die for. I arrived a little early and they let me check in early. We also were able to leave our bags when we checked out so we could venture downtown. it was amazing I never want to stay at another hotel again!

I tried the Cafe Borgia since it is their signature latte. I am so glad I did. It is absolute perfection! The rosemary and goat cheese quiche was also delicious. The staff is very friendly and the seating is comfortable. I hung out and worked on my laptop for a bit. Free wifi is always a plus! This is definitely a neighborhood place. Parking is very limited.
I just went for a Plain Jane and it was damn good. Went next door for some vanilla ice cream with popcorn on top, and that was damn good as well. Yes, I definitely recommend and will go back.

Believe it or not I prefer the experiences and meals I've had here to the higher end Harvest Room. The service is always bang on. The food, while simple, is dead one 9 times out of 10 (had butter chicken once that was crummy). I keep coming here because I love the super comfy chairs, atmospheric room, fab fireplace and ultra friendly & professional staff. If you think about it, burger and a drink for $25 with all the service & quality this place offers - it's the best deal in town.

Best kept secret in the Odessa/Land O' Lakes area. Food is awesome and incredibly fresh. Indoor/Outdoor seating right on a large pond. Doesn't even feel like you are in a neighborhood. Will definitely be back!

If you're looking for an authentic Asian grocery store, this is the place. They have things here I have never seen any other grocery store. When I'm on this side of town I come in for specific things I cannot buy anywhere else. Everything I see is so fresh. You have to give them a try.

Build your own hash? yes please! Wish we found this place yesterday. The corned beef in my hash was sooo good. The girl working out front is a sweetheart and very personable. Next time we are in town we will be back and you should too!

If you do anything when eating here get the pancakes!!! Also, the grits (even without cheese) are some of the best grits I have ever had! And I'm from the south and grew up eating a southern breakfast my entire life. This place is adorable and we didn't have to wait at all! It's now a must for when I visit New Orleans! Which is a continuously growing list... haha

Wedding Planning, awesome. My daughter got married here on May 31st. Celia, the wedding planner at the hotel deserved the biggest tip of all. She is a Wedding Planner, not a hotel employee. She was there for every aspect of the event but never in the way. She checked ballroom temperature after the guests arrived and turned the AC up, guarded gifts and envelopes, ensured bars were stocked and so much more. And, they can, and did served restaurant quality food at the reception. Nice rooms, great location, close to many things to do. This Hilton gets weddings, Celia brings it all together. Thanks for a great experience!
Hands down the best authentic Mexican food I've had in Nashville. Not further comment needed. Just go try it on own and I'm sure you'll feel the same way.

one of the best boba places in Indy. The workers are all always super willing to help with recommendations and making sure you're happy with your drink (give a lot of samples and they remake drinks if there's anything wrong). Really wide variety of drinks so it never gets boring! love this place

Go! Just go, for your own sake. Don't cut your time, because after you see the "Boundaries" film, you'll want to spend a lot of time. 3-4 hours is not unusual. Go and be moved and more appreciative for this wonderful country.
